jobs.title: Learning and Development Program Specialist supporting Nvidia
jobs.description:
**Sustainable Talent** is partnering with **NVIDIA**, a global leader that has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 25 years. We are now looking for a **Learning and Development Program Specialist** to support Nvidia's growing team.

  

This is a full-time (W-2) **contract** role based in **Santa Clara, CA.** We offer competitive pay **$40/hr - $50/hr** based on factors like experience, education, location, etc. and provide full benefits, PTO, and amazing company culture!

  

Learning & Development Coordinators work closely with Learning Program Managers to support and deliver our learning programs. We are looking for someone who works independently and collaboratively, enjoys cross-functional partnerships, and brings solid experience in learning program management.

  

**What you will be doing:**

* Planning the learning calendar based on organizational needs.
* Coordinating 1:1 coaching programs end to end.
* Producing and managing online, live, and hybrid learning events.
* Handling program communications and LMS administration.
* Developing and curating learning resources and marketing materials.
* Preparing speakers and instructors for successful delivery.
* Tracking learning data and managing learner communities on Slack and Teams.
* Gathering feedback, managing deliverables, and mitigating risks to drive program adoption.

  

**What we need to see:**

* Someone who enjoys creative problem-solving and can take our client's learning roadmap from concept to execution, managing rollout, adoption, and ongoing maintenance along the way.
* **Background in adult learning:** degrees in Education, Psychology, or Communications, or equivalent experience in learning roles.
* Hands-on experience coordinating **global learning programs at scale** with an aptitude for experimentation and iteration.
* Proficiency with business and AI tools including Claude, ChatGPT, MS Office, Smartsheet, Lovable, and Canva.

  

**About Sustainable Talent**

Sustainable Talent is a certified woman-owned company specializing in recruitment, consulting, and workforce solutions. We partner with innovative organizations to connect exceptional talent with meaningful opportunities across technology, engineering, operations, and professional services.

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sustainable Talent is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

jobs.title: Digital Literacy Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**POSITION:** Digital Literacy Program Coordinator

**REPORTS TO:** Volunteer Program Manager

**THE ORGANIZATION:** Conard House, Inc. is a non-profit organization that focuses on empowering people and restoring hope for our community members and workforce. We work with a diverse adult population and strive for cultural competency by respecting experience, promoting inclusion and building community. The position is with the SF Connected program, which provides various services including: computer training, resume building, tablet training, social media training, and other services that improve the quality of life/independence of older adults and adults with disabilities in San Francisco. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Conard House is a committed equal opportunity employer.

**QUALIFICATIONS:** High School Diploma required; Bachelor's degree preferred. Must have at least two years of experience in a technology-focused, educational, or human services role working with diverse populations. Demonstrate the ability to clearly communicate ideas, information, and technical concepts to individuals and groups with varying levels of knowledge, education, and digital literacy, while providing troubleshooting, training, and technology guidance in a supportive and accessible manner. Demonstrate positive customer service and client-centered approaches when interacting with participants, staff, volunteers, and community members. Must be comfortable with public speaking, group facilitation, and delivering presentations, classes, or workshops. Demonstrate experience developing, implementing, and evaluating curriculum, educational materials, or training programs, as well as coordinating projects and collaborating effectively across diverse teams, departments, and community partners. Experience working with and supervising volunteers is highly desirable. Must complete a background check after conditional job offer.

**DUTIES:**

* Develop curriculum for classes that is suitable for Conard House consumers that will include usage of computers and commonly used software and apps.
* Train and assist consumers on assistive technologies and accessibility features to promote independence and enhance consumers’ daily living.
* Design and implement training programs that will help improve and enhance daily living for consumers.
* Assist consumers with job search process, including resume revision, cover letter composition, and online applications.
* Assist consumers with troubleshooting on personal tech devices, platforms, and processes. Maintain the ability to adjust approach(es) as needed to best suit consumer needs.
* Host/train consumers and volunteers on video conferencing platforms/software to allow clients to learn, participate/engage in virtual activities and virtual learning opportunities.
* Coordinate workshops, guest speakers, and special events that promote digital inclusion and community engagement.
* Deliver personalized strength-based training; encourage and support participant interaction.
* Coordinate, train, support, and oversee volunteers and interns assisting with Digital Literacy programming.
* Develop and disseminate program materials to all Conard sites.
* Conduct program outreach, both internally at associated Conard sites as well as with potential and established external partners.
* Coordinate class scheduling with site supervisors in the community.
* Design group activities that promote social connection opportunities for consumers.
* Track program objectives and class attendance, including individual usage and student progress.
* Collect & compile data for distribution of monthly reports and input data into the appropriate database.
* Coordinate Digital Literacy program inventory, including ordering and tracking incoming and outgoing devices.
* Maintain accurate program records and ensure compliance with agency, contract, and confidentiality requirements.
* Manage technology equipment, coordinate security of equipment at sites, report issues with equipment or lab operations.
* Coordinate and network with other agencies that are participating in SF Connected. Attend meetings as required.
* Maintain a classroom environment suitable for collaborative learning.
* Be available to assist consumers virtually and remotely.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager
jobs.description:
***The Company***

Halo Industries has developed breakthrough technology to revolutionize a decades-old semiconductor material slicing process. Our laser-based solution minimizes waste, enhances material cost efficiency, and drives innovations across high-growth markets, including automotive, telecommunications, and power electronics. Founded in 2014 at Stanford University, Halo received significant funding in 2024, paving the way for rapid expansion, strategic customer engagement, and the launch of volume manufacturing.

***The Opportunity***

We are seeking a highly strategic and technical Supply Chain Program Manager to join our supply chain team. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing and managing both the highly specialized raw materials required for our wafers and the critical electromechanical components needed to build our proprietary manufacturing equipment.

You will also develop comprehensive sourcing strategies, manage robust supplier relationships, drive cost and quality improvements, and lead complex procurement processes.

***Key Responsibilities***

Strategic Sourcing & Category Management

* Develop and Execute Commodity Strategies: Create comprehensive, multi-year sourcing strategies for raw materials and capital equipment sub-components.
* Market Intelligence: Continuously monitor global market conditions, raw material indices, and geopolitical factors impacting the semiconductor and supply chains. Conduct deep market research and analysis to identify technological trends, evaluate supplier capabilities, and proactively identify potential global risks within assigned commodity categories
* Dual-Sourcing Initiatives: Identify, qualify, and onboard primary and secondary suppliers to mitigate risk and eliminate single points of failure in the supply chain.

Supplier Relationship Management

* Contract Negotiation: Lead complex negotiations for Master Supply Agreements, Statements of Work, and pricing contracts.
* Performance Monitoring: Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews with key suppliers to evaluate performance against rigorous Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Innovation metrics.
* Capacity Planning: Work closely with suppliers to ensure their manufacturing capacity aligns with our long-term production forecasts and equipment build schedules.
* Supplier Relations: Research, select, and manage strategic suppliers; conduct performance reviews, monitor KPIs (quality, delivery), and negotiate contracts.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* New Product Introduction: Partner with R&D and the NPI Team during the design phase of new tools to ensure Design for Manufacturability and supply chain viability.
* Cost Reduction: Collaborate with engineering and manufacturing to identify Value Analysis/Value Engineering opportunities, thereby driving down the Bill of Materials cost
* Escalation Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for critical supply shortages, leading cross-functional task forces to resolve bottlenecks and prevent production downtime.
* Program Management: Collaborate daily with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, NPI, and Finance teams to align commodity strategies with overall business objectives, production schedules, and product design phases. Participate in corporate continuous improvement initiatives to enhance end-to-end supply chain processes, reduce lifecycle costs, and mitigate risks.

  
**Requirements**

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering (Mechanical, Materials Science, or Electrical), Business, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management, or supply chain within the semiconductor, capital equipment, or advanced materials industries.
* Proficiency reading engineering drawings and understand complex technical specifications related to both raw materials (purity levels, material properties) and equipment components (tolerances, vacuum standards).
* Experience performing complex cost modeling, Should-Cost analysis, and Total Cost of Ownership evaluations.
* Experience utilizing ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite) and PLM software (e.g., Arena).
* Direct experience in the semiconductor or related high-tech industries.
* Direct experience supporting New Product Introductions (NPI), including supplier selection and qualification for engineering prototypes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced negotiation skills with a history of executing favorable long-term contracts in volatile markets.

* Experience developing and executing successful, long-term global commodity sourcing strategies for specialized materials or capital equipment components.
* Familiarity with global supply chain management complexity, geopolitical factors, and risk mitigation planning.
* Experience with the complexities of compliance driven procurement for automotive or IATF 16949.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

**Other Requirements**

* This is a full-time role primarily based onsite at our Santa Clara, CA office.
* Some domestic and international travel may be required (up to 10%).

 **Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Free Food & Snacks
* Stock Option Plan
* Annual Bonus Plan eligible
* Short Term & Long Term Disability

* Base Salary: $140,000 - $160,000

*Additional Information*

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued and supported. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including those from underrepresented communities in STEM. If you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Lab Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
Eikon Therapeutics is a new biopharmaceutical company employing revolutionary technology at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, computation, and biology to discover novel treatments for life-threatening diseases. Eikon's discovery platform is built on groundbreaking innovations from its founders (Nobel Prize, 2014), culminating in the creation of microscopes which enable real time, molecular-resolution measurements of protein movement in living cells, thereby unlocking otherwise intractable classes of proteins as drug targets.

**Position**  
As the Lab Ops Supervisor, you will oversee day-to-day operations of our chemistry labs, supervise 1 direct report (lab support technician), directly report to the Senior Director, and work closely with research teams to ensure optimal lab performance. You will be responsible for maintaining laboratory equipment, managing chemical inventory and solvent preparation, enforcing safety protocols, and fostering a collaborative work environment.

**About you**  
A highly organized and proactive professional with strong communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills. Able to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and effectively support laboratory operations and scientific teams. Adaptable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic research environment.

**What You'll Do:**

* Supervise and assist laboratory technicians by delegating tasks and regularly monitoring their progress to ensure the completion of assignments and the efficient use of resources.
* Carry out designated routine activities.
* Ensure the upkeep and calibration of laboratory equipment, guaranteeing its constant readiness for operation.
* Manage and track equipment inventory and equipment monitoring.
* Prepare and maintain solvent and reagent stock solutions to support daily lab operations.
* Maintain accurate chemical inventory, including tracking stock levels, expiration dates, proper labeling, and storage.
* Handle and coordinate the disposal of hazardous chemical waste in compliance with EPA, OSHA, and other applicable regulations.
* Manage procurement of lab supplies and chemicals, including vendor coordination and purchase orders.
* Enforce lab safety rules, hazardous material handling, and waste disposal practices.
* Develop and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for lab processes and safety protocols.
* Evaluate laboratory performance and advise on improvements to optimize efficiency.
* Promote teamwork, provide guidance, and help your team grow professionally.

This position requires participation in an on-call rotation for one week per month.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree with 2+ years of experience in a related scientific field (Biology, Chemistry, etc.).
* Bachelor's degree in Chemistry preferred.
* Proven leadership experience in a lab setting.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Good communication skills for working with your team and researchers.
* Knowledge of lab safety protocols and equipment handling.
* Comfortable using lab software and data analysis tools.
* A commitment to maintaining a safe and productive work environment.

At Eikon, employee compensation also includes bonus and equity compensation, in addition to several generous benefit programs, including:

* 401k plan with company matching
* Medical (premiums covered by Eikon at 95%), dental and vision insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%)
* Mental health and wellness benefits
* Weeklong summer and winter holiday shutdowns
* Generous paid time off and holiday policies
* Life/AD&D Insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%) and optional supplemental employee-paid life/AD&D policies
* Enhanced parental leave benefit
* Daily subsidized lunch program when on-site

The expected salary range for this role is $95,000 to $105,000 depending on skills, competency, and the market demand for your expertise.

Eikon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment.

We are currently not accepting any new third-party agencies or firms at this time. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our website, employees or Human Resources. Eikon Therapeutics will not pay fees to any third-party agency or firm associated with unsolicited resumes.

Our managed inventory programs are designed to support manufacturing OEM’s with their engineered production material specifications, fulfillment, and quality requirements.

**Operations Manager Benefits****:** Gexpro Services offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* Competitive compensation plus annual bonus
* Medical, dental, vision, life insurance and pet insurance
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Employee assistance program and Health wellness programs
* 401(k) immediately with a competitive match
* Several paid holidays and paid time off that includes personal, sick and vacation time.

**Operations Manager Job Summary and Essential Responsibilities:**

The Operations Manager is responsible for driving operational performance, customer service, inventory accuracy, and execution across the site. This role provides leadership to operational teams, including the Warehouse Manager, and serves as the primary owner of operational results.

The Operations Manager is accountable for achieving service, productivity, inventory, quality, and cost objectives through effective leadership, cross-functional collaboration, performance management, and continuous improvement. * Analyze operational data and trends to identify performance risks, improvement opportunities, and resource requirements.

jobs.description:
P-1495

### **About Databricks**

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

**About the Role**
------------------

Databricks is seeking a **Senior Staff Strategic Product Operations Manager** to serve as the chief architect of our internal operational ecosystem. This is a high-leverage leadership role embedded within Engineering, designed to orchestrate the complex intersection of technical innovation, product lifecycle maturity, and global Go-to-Market (GTM) acceleration.

In this capacity, you will move beyond the management of existing processes to lead the creation of a formal **Operational Association**. You will be responsible for designing the high-fidelity frameworks that allow our engineering organization to remain agile while ensuring that every product investment is data-driven, transparent, and rigorously aligned with our long-term commercial strategy. This role is purpose-built for a strategic thinker who excels at navigating the "gray space" between a deep technical roadmap and the sophisticated financial requirements of a global enterprise platform.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Business Marketing Group connects businesses with their customers on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger to help them grow their businesses through solutions like pages, advertising, messaging, and more. We succeed when we help our customers grow their business leveraging our solutions. The Global Marketing Operations team runs campaign execution for business marketing, launching hundreds of campaigns a year across an expanding set of digital marketing channels.We are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager who executes campaigns AI-first, pairing deep expertise in marketing execution platforms with the AI skills to automate that work. This role is about owning operational quality by setting executional standards that can be built at agent scale. The ideal candidate is a digital marketing expert who has already replaced meaningful parts of their own workflow with AI and can show what it produced.  
  
  

### **Marketing Operations Manager Responsibilities:**

* Own campaign execution and execution quality for an assigned business area, from brief through launch, across lifecycle, email, in-product messaging, web, and Meta ads

* Pilot new delivery capabilities, then codify what correct execution looks like and the eval rubrics that hold agents to it
* Advise partners at the brief stage on what is executable and at what cost, and translate execution learnings into platform requirements
* Raise the AI capability of the team through documentation, enablement, and coaching
* Find new ways to continually streamline execution processes, including working with XFNs (if needed) to automate handoff

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign management, or marketing automation
* Hands-on build experience in at least two digital marketing channels among email, paid social, in-product messaging, web, and SEM or display, with expert-level depth in at least one execution or ads platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, HubSpot, Adobe)
* Demonstrated use of AI to produce real marketing work output, with specific examples of what was automated and the measured effect on time, cost, quality, or volume
* Hands-on experience building, configuring, and evaluating AI agents or LLM-based workflows, including prompt iteration and judgment on where output requires human review
* Experience owning campaign execution at portfolio scale, including QA and trade-off decisions across competing requests
* Experience scaling impact beyond own execution, through standards others adopted, requirements platform teams built, and enablement that raised team capability

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The position will be based in Vacaville, and due to the nature of the job we do require our team to live in the area. *Weekends & Evenings Required! No exceptions.*

We are interested in candidates who are looking for long-term employment and find a homebase for their career.

**SUMMARY**

Sunrise is a thriving event venue located in Vacaville, CA. We host a wide variety of events ranging from Weddings & Quinceaneras to Corporate Meetings & Community Galas.

The ideal candidate would be highly organized, a natural leader, possess excellent communication skills, stay calm in stressful situations, and be able to juggle a wide array of responsibilities. As Event Operations Manager you must be present for and oversee all events in order to ensure a high level of guest satisfaction and seamless event coordination. You will ensure everything is accounted for before, during, & after each event.

You will serve as liaison and contact person for coordinating details of events with clients, outside vendors, meeting planners, chefs, decorators, DJs and others.

This is a salaried Position and although your schedule revolves around our events, expect to consistently work around 40-50 hours a week. Sunrise provides an exciting and Dynamic work environment so don't expect to be tethered to your desk - especially during events when you will be on your feet constantly. Typically you will be working 2-3 weekdays in order to effectively complete administrative tasks and plan for events. The remainder of your work schedule will be on Friday, Saturday, & Sundays during the events themselves (3pm - 1am typically).

There is room for growth in this company; this is the perfect opportunity to display your skills in the hospitality/events industry and find a reliable foundation for your career.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

*PLANNING & COORDINATION*

* Liaise with and manage all communication with each in-house vendor/department - DJs, Decorators, Caterers, Photobooth, etc. in order to ensure seamless coordination
* Design, confirm, and communicate room layouts and set-up requirements for events using Prismm/All-Seated. The ability to physically assist with Setups will be required if needed.
* Oversee Setup Technician & Janitorial staff, and direct them on daily tasks and duties, including linen laundry, janitorial needs, and maintenance needs.
* Review inventories and place orders for supplies as needed.
* Prepare weekly staff schedules and assist with Payroll on a biweekly basis
* Conduct ‘Final Details’ meetings with clients before each event.
* Ensure client files are up to date and all details are accurately reflected in our system; update relevant parties with changes as they arise
* Offer detailed and timely distribution of all Banquet Event Orders, which outline all final inclusions for events so as to ensure smooth event operations.
* Manage Catering menus and team needs (Food signage, Food Tastings, etc.)

*EVENT RESPONSIBILITIES - First to arrive and last to leave*

* Ensure every detail for the event is ready
* Control lighting, AV equipment, etc. and ensure ballroom is event ready when the event starts
* Direct Staff (bartenders, servers, dishwashers, security, etc.) upon arrival and ensure all team members are completing tasks and providing guests with exceptional service
* Manage issues during the event if/as they arise
* Communicate effectively with clients to ensure their needs are addressed/anticipated
* Manage staff after the event and ensure ballrooms are tidy and ready according to client needs and upcoming events
* Close out files upon event completion and ensure financials are accurate.

*CLIENT & STAFF INTERACTION*

* Work closely with Administrative Assistant and Sales Team to ensure seamless event planning experience both internally with the team, and externally with clients & 3rd party vendors.
* Be smartly dressed in appropriate attire.
* Promote a positive and professional manner at all times
* Assist in building strong relations with Sunrise staff, partner hotel staff, and outside agencies/vendors.
* Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards by developing & following checklists
* Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests' service needs, and thank guests with genuine appreciation.
* Onboard new hires & maintain organized staff files

**IDEAL CANDIDATES:**

* Proven management experience in events, catering and/or hospitality operations is required
* Ability to lead and organize large teams.
* Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize and perform a wide variety of tasks over the course of the workday; must be accurate and conscientious.
* Excellent oral and written communication/interpersonal skills
* Well-organized and responsible with a Strong attention to detail and appreciation for high standards
* Excellent computer skills (MS Office, Google Suite, Tripleseat, etc.)
* A team player with a high level of dedication to collective success.
* Strong background in negotiation and customer service skills required. An aptitude in rapid problem-solving will be an asset
* Ability to read, write, and speak English [Spanish, Punjabi, and Hindi are highly desired]

**A Brief Overview**  
The Supply Chain Strategic Initiatives Project Manager is responsible for leading and delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives that directly support and enable the Supply Chain Strategic Plan. This role works across a multi-disciplinary Supply Chain with matrixed teams. Operating within a matrix reporting structure, this position partners closely with Supply Chain leadership, clinical leaders, and operational stakeholders across the organization. The role requires a deep understanding of end-to-end Supply Chain operations and systems, and the ability to translate strategic priorities into executable projects and initiatives that deliver measurable operational, financial, and service outcomes. An important component of this role is organizational change management. The Strategic Initiatives Project Manager is responsible for ensuring projects and initiatives are successfully adopted and sustained across a highly complex healthcare environment. The role provides thought leadership, analytical insight, decision support, and project oversight for initiatives related to operating model design, workflow optimization, resiliency planning, supplier performance, contract effectiveness, disruption response, and data-driven planning within Supply Chain. The Project Manager serves as a key liaison between Supply Chain, clinical and operational end users, vendors, and external partners, as it pertains to projects and initiatives assigned. The PM will consistently model professionalism, diplomacy, cultural sensitivity, and composure under pressure in alignment with Stanford Health Care's C-I-CARE values.  
  
**Locations**  
Stanford Health Care  
  
**What you will do**

* Lead and support projects and initiatives that collectively deliver against the Supply Chain Strategic Plan.
* Apply structured project management methodologies to drive initiatives from planning through execution, adoption, and sustainment of key program and operational objectives.
* Establish and maintain collaborative relationships with leaders and teams across Supply Chain.
* Partner with clinical and operational end users ensuring initiatives are designed for these operational environments.
* Assess current-state workflows and operational performance, and partner with stakeholders to design future-state processes that improve service, efficiency, cost, and resiliency.
* Provide analytical and decision support, including business case development, performance metrics, risk assessment, and executive-level reporting.
* Lead organizational change management activities, including stakeholder engagement, change impact analysis, communication planning, training coordination, and adoption measurement.
* Clearly document project scope, objectives, success measures, dependencies, and constraints to ensure shared understanding and accountability.
* Develop and support policies, guidelines, and standard work that enable consistent and sustainable Supply Chain practices.
* Ensure initiatives comply with hospital, university, and regulatory requirements, including patient confidentiality, data security, and operational standards.
* Maintain regular, transparent communication regarding project status, risks, issues, and required actions.
* Establish and monitor performance metrics to evaluate outcomes; partner with leaders to adjust and remediate issues when needed.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and change readiness across Supply Chain functions.

  
**Education Qualifications**

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Associate
jobs.description:
**About SleepRes**

SleepRes is developing next-generation sleep apnea therapy technologies that improve patient outcomes. We are a small, fast-moving R&D team focused on building high-quality medical devices that make a real-world impact.

**Position Summary**

The Quality Assurance (QA) Associate supports the daily operation and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) for Class II medical devices. Reporting to the Quality Manager, this role coordinates document control, manages day-to-day training program activities, administers the electronic QMS (eQMS), and supports customer feedback and complaint handling.

The QA Associate works with Quality, Regulatory, Engineering, Operations, and Customer Care to maintain accurate, complete, and audit-ready records. This is an individual contributor role that supports design control, risk management, and medical device software compliance under the Quality Manager's direction.

**Responsibilities**

**Document Control**

* Administer document control activities within the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS), including document creation, review, approval routing, release, revision, distribution, obsolescence, and archival in accordance with approved procedures.

* Maintain document numbering, revision history, effective dates, controlled templates, and applicable external standards within the eQMS, ensuring obsolete or superseded documents are appropriately controlled and protected from unintended use.

* Review documents and change records for completeness, formatting, required approvals, and associated training assignments; follow up on open actions.

**Training Program Management**

* Administer the company training program through the eQMS, including maintenance of the training matrix, role-based curricula, onboarding requirements, recurring training, and training triggered by new or revised controlled documents.

* Support onboarding and role changes by ensuring employees are assigned the appropriate eQMS training curricula based on job responsibilities.

* Assign and track training in the eQMS, follow up on overdue assignments, and report completion status to the Quality Manager and department leads.

* Maintain training and competency records, including evidence of training effectiveness where required by procedures.

**eQMS Administration**

* Support eQMS day-to-day administration, including approved user access, workflows, document and training modules, and user assistance.

* Support controlled configuration changes, data migration, testing, and validation documentation under approved plans; escalate system and data integrity issues.

Feedback and Complaint Support

* Log customer feedback and complaints, obtain missing information, and maintain traceability to the device, serial number, event, and supporting records.

* Coordinate follow-up with Customer Care, Engineering, and Operations; support complaint investigations, record completeness checks, and tracking to closure.

* Promptly escalate potential safety issues and time-sensitive events to Quality and Regulatory for evaluation and reporting decisions; prepare complaint and feedback trend summaries.

**Design Control Risk Management and Software Compliance Support**

* Maintain and organize design and development records, including design reviews, verification and validation evidence, traceability matrices, and design change documentation.

* Support maintenance of risk management records and links among identified hazards, risk controls, verification evidence, and post-market feedback using knowledge of ISO 14971.

* Support review and organization of software lifecycle records using knowledge of IEC 62304 requirements, including software requirements, verification, configuration and change management, and problem resolution.

**Quality System Support**

* Support internal and external audits by retrieving records and tracking assigned actions; assist with nonconformance and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) documentation.

* Compile quality metrics, identify record gaps, and follow up on assigned actions. Escalate compliance concerns and decisions requiring approval to the Quality Manager.

**Experience and Required Knowledge**

* 3-5 years of experience in medical device quality or related quality systems work, including experience with Class II medical devices.

* Practical experience with document control, training coordination, and electronic document or quality management systems.

* Working knowledge of FDA Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), 21 CFR Part 820, and ISO 13485 quality system requirements.

* Knowledge of medical device design control, ISO 14971 risk management, and IEC 62304 medical device software lifecycle requirements.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in engineering, biomedical engineering, life sciences, quality, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with CPAP or other respiratory therapy devices, connected hardware/software medical devices, or eQMS implementation.

* Experience supporting complaint handling, audits, CAPA, or software verification and validation documentation.

**Key Competencies and Work Environment**

Strong attention to detail, organization, communication, and follow-through. Ability to manage multiple assignments, handle confidential information, and collaborate across technical and customer-facing teams in a medical device development and commercial environment.

jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union-eligible position.
  
**The required shift for this position is:** Monday-Friday, 8:00am-4:30pm
  
  
JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  
The HealthRIGHT 360 ECM program is based in the Integrated Care Center Clinic, a federally qualified health center that provides primary care, behavioral health, addiction treatment, psychiatry, dental care, and more. We provide care to those most in need including those who are suffering from homelessness, mental illness, substance use, mental illness, and chronic medical conditions. We provide team-based care in an integrated care setting. We are looking for a mission driven service leader who works well in a team, has experience with managing and supporting members, champions quality improvement, leads change, and is excited to innovate.
  
  
The Care Manager will provide intensive, client-centered case management to support both patients in the ICC and across other HealthRIGHT 360 programs in San Francisco, in achieving stability, health, and self-sufficiency. The Case Manager I, under the Enhanced Care Management (ECM) program, is responsible for maintaining a caseload of members enrolled in a Managed Care Plan (MCP). This role focuses on delivering community-based case management services, linking clients to appropriate resources to address needs such as health benefits, physical and behavioral health care, substance use treatment, housing, employment, justice-involved issues, family services, and other social supports. In partnership with the San Francisco Health Plan and HealthRIGHT 360’s Integrated Care Clinic (ICC)—a brick-and-mortar primary care site located at 1563 Mission Street in San Francisco—the Care Manager I provides coordinated care to a diverse patient population. This includes collaboration with clinical and community providers to ensure comprehensive service delivery.
  
  
This is a field-based position requiring proactive outreach and engagement with members in the community, including visits to clients' homes, service provider sites, and other locations across San Francisco.

jobs.title: Program Manager, AV Safety Policy & Programs
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is building the safety capability for autonomous mobility. As Program Manager, AV Safety Policy & Programs, you'll own key parts of Lyft's AV Safety Management System (SMS) across all four pillars: Safety Policy, Safety Risk Management, Safety Assurance, and Safety Promotion. You'll also make sure the processes, documentation, and cross-functional machinery behind them work in practice.

This is a high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of safety policy, program design, and cross-functional process support. You'll author policy, run risk and review cadences, turn safety data into decisions, and keep the Safety Review Board (SRB) running. You'll work closely with AV partners, and you can speak credibly about AV safety with technical counterparts, senior leaders, and external partners.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Safety Policy:** Own Lyft's AV safety policy framework, safety procedures, and partner-facing governance documentation, including version control and periodic review cycles. Maintain governance charters, committee operating rhythms, and escalation protocols.
* **Safety Risk Management:** Run hazard identification and risk assessment for AV operations and new launches. Maintain the operational risk register and track mitigations to closure.
* **Safety Assurance:** Track safety performance indicators and trends, and surface emerging risks. Participate in incident and near-miss investigations and own corrective action (CAPA) tracking, so findings feed back into policy, operations, and partner work plans. Coordinate evidence and remediation for audits and certifications.
* **Safety Promotion:** Drive safety communications, lessons-learned documentation, and training readiness.
* **Safety Review Board:** Run the SRB cadence, including agendas, materials, decision records, and follow-through on action items.
* **Partner Engagement:** Contribute to the standards and assessment frameworks Lyft uses with AV partners, and support partners' safety assurance and risk management activities.
* **Program Execution:** Drive AV safety programs with safety leaders, including partners across EHS, Operations, Engineering, Legal, and others from inception through go-live. This includes safety readiness for new market launches and partner integrations.

**Experience:**
---------------

* 4+ years supporting or managing safety management programs in a safety-critical transportation industry (AV, aviation, rail, automotive, trucking, or equivalent)
* Working knowledge of SMS principles and how they apply to AV operations
* Hands-on experience with risk assessment, incident follow-up, and corrective action tracking
* Strong technical writing, including policy, procedures, and partner- or regulator-facing materials
* Comfort with safety data, including tracking indicators, spotting trends, and presenting findings to technical and senior audiences
* Proven ability to run multi-stakeholder programs without direct authority
* Bachelor's degree in safety, engineering, policy, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* **Nice to Have**
  + Familiarity with AV safety frameworks (e.g., AVSC best practices) and US AV reporting requirements
  + Experience supporting robotaxi, ridehail, or fleet operations
  + Experience operating in a matrixed, partner-dependent environment where safety policy must be implemented through influence rather than direct control
  + Exposure to multi-market or international safety operations

**Benefits:**
-------------

* Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
* Mental health benefits
* Family building benefits
* Child care and pet benefits
* 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
* In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
* 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
* Subsidized commuter benefits
* Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, Energy Storage
jobs.description:
**About Redwood Materials**

**Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.**

**Position Summary:**

The Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, Energy Storage is a career-level individual contributor role that owns program management across all commodities supporting the Energy Storage business. The role builds and maintains the integrated supply chain schedule across commodity owners, suppliers, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Finance, tracks supplier milestones and risks, and drives material readiness for new product introduction builds and production ramp. The role works independently and is reviewed at critical points. This is a fully on-site role in our San Francisco R&D space, with approximately 10% international travel to supplier sites.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead the integrated supply chain program plan across all Energy Storage commodities (for example, electronics PCBAs, mechanical components, energy equipment, solar panels, and harnesses), tracking milestones, dependencies, and resources across suppliers and internal teams
* Serve as the liaison between Supply Chain commodity teams and Programs, Engineering, Manufacturing, Finance, and leadership, communicating program status, key milestones, and risks
* Identify supply and schedule risks early, and devise and drive mitigation plans with commodity owners and suppliers
* Coordinate supplier readiness for new product introduction builds and production ramp, including capacity, qualification, and delivery plans
* Track supply chain program metrics (cost, lead time, delivery performance, inventory) across commodities and report results to leadership
* Resolve cross-functional issues and escalations that affect program schedule, cost, or quality
* Develop and improve program management tools, templates, and processes for supply chain programs

**Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of program management, supply chain, or sourcing experience (3+ years with a Master's degree), ideally in energy storage, battery, EV, or electronics manufacturing
* Working knowledge of new product introduction, production ramp, and supply chain operations across electronic, mechanical, and electromechanical commodities
* Experience building and managing integrated schedules, milestone trackers, and risk registers across multiple stakeholders and commodity teams
* Ability to analyze supply chain data (cost, lead time, delivery, inventory) to identify trends and risks
* Ability to communicate program status and risks clearly, in writing and verbally, to cross-functional partners and leadership
* Ability to travel internationally to supplier sites approximately 10% of the time

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

  

We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Redwood Materials, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, professional or employment information, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

jobs.title: OG.com - Senior Product Manager - Fiat Onboarding
jobs.description:
### **About Us**

  

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology. We’re building an engaging marketplace where users trade on real-world outcomes - from major sports and elections to cultural and financial events. With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets. OG.com runs on the rails of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (NADEX), a CFTC-regulated exchange operating since 2004 and was acquired by crypto.com in 2022.

### **Role Overview**

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to own how money and identity get into OG: signup, KYC, fiat funding, payouts, and the funding experience behind all of it. Fans can’t trade until they can fund, so every drop-off in onboarding or funding costs us volume, trust, and share of wallet.

Your job is to make funded accounts fast and trustworthy, with a design bar you won’t lower. You’ll own the path from signup through KYC and funding to a trade-ready account: the funding methods that actually clear, the failure states that quietly kill conversion, and the feedback loops that move the funnel. Trading surfaces like markets, parlays, and live sit with a partner PM. The front door is yours.

The funding product is yours end to end, including funding methods, limits, retries, risk configuration, and partner UX. You won’t be negotiating bank charters. You’ll be deciding what ships, when, and at what balance of friction against compliance. You’ll report to the VP of Product, who sets strategy across Financial Services while you own the how and the when for OG.com.

### **What You'll Actually Do:**

* **Own onboarding and funding end to end.** Signup, verify, deposit, time-to-funded. You make the call on where to trade friction for compliance. The job isn’t shipping a KYC screen; it’s getting people from signup to funded to ready for their first trade.
* **Own the funding product.** You decide funding methods, payouts, limits, retries, and partner UX, spanning ACH, cards, instant funding, and whatever else clears in the U.S. Authorization and flow of funds are product decisions to you, not a ticket you file with a vendor.
* **Treat the money-in funnel as a growth surface.** You instrument the drop-off, go after the leaks, and sequence your work against conversion. On the handoff from funded to first contract, you partner with the Predictions PM.
* **Hold the design bar on trust and money UX.** Clarity, hierarchy, and clean error states aren’t negotiable. When someone’s entering a debit card or waiting on an ACH, “good enough” doesn’t cut it, and you’ll say so. Your feedback is specific: interaction cost, copy, recovery paths, not vibes.
* **Wireframe and partner on design.** You build your own wires and drive the design conversation, catching the clunky funding and KYC moments before users hit them.
* **Talk to users like a peer.** You run research on how people really sign up, verify, and move money. You ask them to show you how they fund an account instead of asking whether they’d use instant deposit.
* **Drive cross-functional execution.** You get engineering, design, data, compliance, payments, and ops working toward the same funded-user outcomes. Nothing in onboarding or funding ships without your sign-off on the product and UX bar.

### **Requirements:**

* **Consumer money-in funnel ownership.** You’ve owned a consumer signup-to-deposit-to-funded flow, and you can walk us through the funnel you ran, the drop-offs you went after, and the number that actually moved. That’s the bar. Merchant acquiring, B2B payouts, and adjacent-team contributions don’t count.
* **Hands-on flow-of-funds ownership at the bank-API layer, not just a gateway.** You’ve done real work integrating bank or embedded-banking APIs, whether direct bank and partner-bank APIs or a banking-as-a-service or rails provider, and you’ve owned a funding method, rail, or failure mode end to end. You can point to a specific flow of funds or failure state you ran yourself: a settlement failure, an ACH return or NACHA edge case, a retry model, a routing decision, a chargeback or liability flow. You don’t need to have built a bank core from scratch, but consuming a payment gateway and filing tickets against it won’t clear this bar. The judgment we need comes from having worked at the money layer, so you’re making sound calls on day one.
* **Design sensibility as a product skill.** You can critique money-in and identity UX with specifics like hierarchy, density, recovery, and trust, not just “it looks nicer.” Tell us about a flow you refused to ship until it was clear.
* **An instinct for why funding has to feel instant.** In a live-event context, a slow or failed deposit is volume lost in real time. You’ve designed under that pressure, or you can show us you get it.
* **Data- and user-driven by default.** You instrument your own funnel, size the opportunity, and prioritize off the numbers without waiting for someone to hand you the analysis. You also go to the source, running your own research on how people sign up, verify, and fund, and letting what you learn reshape the roadmap. Both the quantitative and the qualitative.

### **Strong Plus:**

* **KYC / identity depth.** You’ve owned identity verification, step-up, or risk-tiered challenge decisions yourself. (If a peer owned KYC while you owned deposits, that’s fine, but identity fluency helps here.)
* **Regulated on/off-ramp or neobank experience.** You’ve sat at the intersection of compliance, rails, and consumer conversion.
* **Prediction-market, sportsbook, or real-money-gaming background.** You know why funding has to feel instant during a live game.
* **Deep design-tool / design-system fluency.** You move faster treating design as a peer discipline rather than a handoff.
* **AI-augmented product work.** You use AI tools with human judgment in the loop to move faster on research,

jobs.title: Account Manager - Expansion
jobs.description:
**About Brightidea**
--------------------

Brightidea is the enterprise innovation management platform behind programs at Merck, J&J, AWS, Cytiva, and hundreds of other global organizations. We've been at this for 26 years, we're profitable, which means small surface area, short decision paths, and a lot of leverage per person.

**About the role**
------------------

You own a book of large, under-penetrated Fortune 1000 accounts where Brightidea holds a beachhead — a single department, a single program, a fraction of what the organization could be running. Your job is to crack those accounts open: build executive sponsorship from a small footprint, multi-thread across a complex organization, and grow toward enterprise-wide adoption while protecting what's already in place.

This is a hunter-builder seat, not a caretaker seat. It carries a real number and real accountability.

We've written it deliberately to screen out the standard enterprise SaaS account manager. If your value is relationship maintenance, QBR cadence, and renewal paperwork, this seat won't suit you and you won't enjoy it.

**Why this isn't a traditional Account Manager role**
-----------------------------------------------------

* **You have to build, not just sell.** Our customers are innovation leaders at Merck, J&J, AWS, Cytiva and their peers, and many of them are now building with AI themselves. You'll sit across from people who can prototype, and you need to prototype alongside them — mock a workflow, model a use case, turn platform usage data into a commercial case without waiting on an engineer or an analyst.
* **You have to hold the harder conversation.** A customer who can build their own tooling will ask why they need a platform at all. Answering that credibly means understanding both what we do and what is genuinely hard to replicate. A polished commercial pitch won't survive that conversation.
* **You'll find your own buyers.** Roughly a third of your book is net-new footprint inside existing logos — new business units, new use cases, new executive sponsors who have never heard of us. Nobody hands you that pipeline.
* **The business is changing underneath the role.** Brightidea is evolving how it engages large enterprises, and this seat sits at the front of that. If ambiguity bothers you, this is the wrong company right now. If you want a role where the shape of the work is still being decided, this is a good moment to arrive.
* **You carry a number and own the outcome.** Blended retention plus growth, reviewed monthly with your manager and quarterly with the executive team. The targets are in this document because we'd rather you know them before you apply.

**The bar: AI fluency is non-negotiable**
-----------------------------------------

This is a hard gate, not a preference. We won't make an offer to a strong commercial candidate who isn't genuinely AI-fluent, regardless of track record. We define it concretely:

* **You've built things.** Automations, agents, scripts, internal tools, integrations — something beyond prompting a chatbot. You should be able to walk us through what you built, why, and what broke.
* **AI is in your daily workflow, not your toolkit.** Account research, org mapping, territory planning, first-draft outreach, data analysis. We'll ask how you actually work, and we'll be able to tell.
* **You can produce a working artifact in front of a customer.** A mock, a prototype, a data cut, a solution sketch — fast enough to be useful in the meeting rather than in the follow-up.
* **You can reason about where AI helps and where it doesn't,** including the limits. We need someone who can tell a customer honestly that one thing is easy to build and another isn't.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Treat each account as a mini-territory: build and execute a penetration plan that moves it from beachhead toward enterprise-wide adoption
* Build executive sponsorship out from a single champion or department, multi-threading across large, political organizations where your original contact may not be your path to the budget
* Own renewal negotiation and close, including price increases and multi-year terms against enterprise procurement
* Source net-new buyers inside existing logos — new business units, adjacent use cases, executives who have never engaged with us
* Convert platform adoption and usage data into commercial cases; program results are your ammunition, and you should be able to pull and shape that data yourself
* Position Brightidea credibly against build-it-yourself alternatives, including customers prototyping with AI
* Forecast accurately and keep a clean cadence across ~25 accounts, concentrating effort where the runway is greatest

  

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

We care about the combination of commercial instinct and technical fluency, not the label on your last job. Three profiles fit:

* **Enterprise expansion** — you've carried a number expanding inside large, complex accounts, in an enterprise motion rather than SMB velocity. You've grown a logo from one business unit to enterprise-wide, or materially grown ARR inside a named account.
* **Consultant / solution architect** — you've delivered into large enterprises from a consulting or professional services background, with genuine commercial exposure: scoping, pricing, expanding engagements. You're comfortable being the person in the room who designs the answer.
* **Founder / operator** — you've built and sold something, carried revenue responsibility end to end, built your own tooling, and are comfortable with the ambiguity of an evolving business.

**Required across all three:**

* Experience navigating enterprise procurement, renewal negotiation, price increases, and multi-year terms
* Multi-threading in complex organizations, where you've built sponsorship starting from one contact and no budget
* A territory-development mindset with a concrete approach to whitespace

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
### **About AppLovin**

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

### **About the Role**

We are seeking a smart, hardworking Business Operations Analyst to provide technical and operational support to our Business Operations (BizOps) team and the systems supporting our mobile-advertising business.

A central part of this role is helping other BizOps analysts deliver reliable projects. You will review their code, debug existing workflows, investigate product issues, and translate business problems into actionable requests for Engineering and Operations. You will also write and maintain your own workflow code and analyze product features and experiments.

You will serve as a practical link between business and technical teams. We're looking for someone who learns quickly, investigates problems independently, exercises good judgment, and follows issues through to resolution.

AI-assisted development is a regular part of how our team works. You should be effective at using these tools and reviewing the code they produce, with the technical understanding to identify mistakes, challenge assumptions, and guide work toward reliable results.

### **Responsibilities**

* Support projects led by other BizOps analysts, helping clarify requirements, review technical approaches, and resolve implementation problems.

* Write and maintain Python code, SQL workflows, integrations, and automations supporting the team's work.
* Investigate product bugs, distinguish expected behavior from defects, and gather evidence through code, logs, data, and reproducible examples.

* Manage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services supporting BizOps workflows, including service accounts, permissions, secrets, configuration, and deployments.
* Support Salesforce workflows and integrations, including programming against its application programming interfaces (APIs).
* Analyze product features, experiments, and operational and advertising data. Apply appropriate statistical methods, interpret results accurately, and explain limitations.
* Investigate discrepancies across internal systems and partner platforms.
* Prioritize competing requests and communicate findings, decisions, blockers, and next steps through concise Slack messages, tickets, and documentation.

### **Qualifications**

* Good judgment about data quality, system changes, permissions, and operational risk. You recognize which problems you can resolve independently and when additional expertise or review is needed.
* Effective use of AI coding and workflow tools to develop, review, and maintain substantial volumes of code. You can evaluate generated work, identify mistakes, and steer it toward the intended outcome.
* Practical experience with Python, SQL, Git, pull-request workflows, and APIs, including investigating and debugging existing code.
* Hands-on experience managing GCP services and workflows, including permissions, credentials, configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Experience applying statistical analysis and data science techniques, including selecting appropriate methods, interpreting results accurately, and explaining limitations.
* Experience in advertising technology, with a working understanding of areas such as campaign delivery, attribution, measurement, mediation, monetization, or the iOS and Android ecosystems.
* Clear, concise written communication. You can explain technical issues in business terms, document reproducible problems, and write requirements and tickets that others can act on.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting internal tools, reviewing other people's code, or coordinating technical work across business, Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Experience with Salesforce administration, reporting, permission models, or integrations.
* Experience maintaining production automations, data pipelines, or shared internal applications.
* Familiarity with least-privilege access and sensitive data handling.

### **What Success Looks Like**

BizOps analysts can rely on you to investigate technical problems, review their work thoughtfully, and help their projects move forward. Engineering and Operations receive clear, actionable req

jobs.title: OG.com - Product Operations - Merchandising & Discovery
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

  

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology. We’re building an engaging marketplace where users trade on real-world outcomes - from major sports and elections to cultural and financial events. With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets. OG.com runs on the rails of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (NADEX), a CFTC-regulated exchange operating since 2004 and was acquired by crypto.com in 2022.

  

**The Problem You'll Solve**

Something is always happening - a game, a vote, a number moving - and OG is where traders come to discover it and make their call. That’s the reflex we’re building: the surface should feel like it was built for this exact moment - every time someone opens the app, their obvious next step should always be acting on what’s happening right now.

You will lead merchandising for OG’s surface - deciding what’s featured, how it’s packaged, and how it evolves in real time. You bring the instincts of someone deeply in tune with sports, politics, and real-world events, paired with fluency in how a prediction market trades, to make OG’s surface feel current and alive at every moment.

You will operate with autonomy - proposing and making the calls on what’s featured, how it’s packaged, and what comes off the board - while working closely with Product and Market Liquidity and Operations to keep the surface moving as fast as the moment does.

### **What You'll Actually Do:**

* Own the merchandised surface end-to-end. You lead decisions on homepage / discovery modules and featured market placement across OG web and mobile - what sits in the hero, what rotates, and what earns its place. Every decision is made against one question: does this get tapped, traded, and come back tomorrow. You make decisions that offer the best commercial quality, working closely with Product along the way.
* Bring proven merchandising craft to prediction markets. You bring instincts for hero carousels, quick-pick modules, thematic tiles, and high-intent packaging, and translate them into prediction-market terms: multi-contract packages, correlated event bundles, and narrative-driven hubs that make trading on a moment feel as easy and exciting as it should.
* Build packaged, high-intent merchandising. You create and rotate packages tied to real narratives, and you package for liquidity and clarity so every trade is easy to understand and act on. You propose and make the call on what ships to the module, in step with Trading and Market Ops.
* Run live merchandising. You swap surfaces in real time during major events - games, elections, breaking news, viral moments. You partner with Market Liquidity & Operations when odds or liquidity shift. You stay calm when the calendar is nights, weekends, and holidays. Speed without sloppiness - you’re managing the public face of the product.
* Connect the calendar to the product. You own the calendar against sports, politics, culture, and market-moving news so launches aren’t a surprise to the homepage. You flag coverage gaps back to Market Ops before the story peaks.
* Make discovery exciting, not just functional. You treat the surface as the reason someone opens the app at all - fresh, current, a little addictive. You know the difference between a homepage that’s operational and one that makes someone want to check it again in twenty minutes.
* Prove it with experiments. You prioritize, QA, and read merchandising A/B tests with Product and Analytics against CTR, conversion, trading volume, and DAU/return-visit lift. You know when a test is invalid. You instrument your own funnel; you don’t wait for someone to hand you the analysis.
* Watch the competitive set and respond. You track competitors closely, and you propose responses, work with engineers and ship them.
* Handoff cleanly with Market Ops. You consume new listings the moment they’re live. You feed unmet demand and broken-resolution UX signals back. Market Ops handles the listing and settlement processes while you own the presentation of our customer-facing product interfaces.

### **Requirements:**

* Surface merchandising you've owned. You have owned sportsbook, iGaming, or marketplace merchandising (modules, features, packages) end-to-end, with a track record of improving engagement, conversion, or volume, and you adapt readily when things move fast and dependencies shift. We care what you've built and owned.
* Live / calendar ops under pressure. You operate comfortably on event time (nights, weekends, holidays), swapping and re-featuring quickly to keep the surface current as moments unfold.

jobs.title: Trust & Safety Product Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

We are hiring a Trust & Safety Product Operations Specialist to investigate safety incidents and work with the Product and Legal teams to prevent the next one. You will report to the Director of Trust & Safety. You will turn what cases and data show into product feedback and process fixes.

This role uses AI throughout. You will prompt it to query data and build tools, and you will answer for what it produces.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Investigations & Policy**

* Run safety investigations from intake through resolution. Weigh conflicting accounts against the evidence, and close each case with a written finding that a second reviewer can verify.
* Handle escalated tickets. Communicate clearly with professionals and partners, and with legal and law enforcement when a case requires it. Tie every resolution to the facts and to our terms.
* Apply Instawork’s Community Guidelines consistently, and propose revisions where cases expose gaps.

### **Data & Metrics**

* Use natural language to generate SQL for our databases. Review each query’s logic and verify its results before you act on them.
* Identify fraud patterns and safety trends yourself, without a technical intermediary. Report what the data supports and where it falls short.
* Track the metrics that show whether Trust & Safety is working, including incident rate, time to first action, appeal overturn rate, and repeat-violation rate. Report results to Product and Legal against targets set by the Director of Trust & Safety.
* Investigate the cause when a metric moves off target, and recommend a response.
* Re-review a sample of closed cases each month to check that findings are accurate and consistent.

### **Product Operations & Automation**

* Test new safety and enforcement features before launch, and send Product written defect reports.
* Help plan outreach to professionals and partners for each new feature, and track adoption from launch.
* Collect and analyze feedback from cases and support channels, and report what it implies for departmental and company planning.
* Build internal tools by prompting AI coding assistants. Check the logic and test the output before a tool touches a live case. Examples include scripts that assemble case evidence and workflows that route incoming reports. Keep data privacy and human review in each tool.
* Find the manual steps that slow investigations and replace them with automation or a tool you build. Maintain what you ship.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 1+ years in Trust & Safety, Operations, or Compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to weigh conflicting accounts and reach a fair finding under pressure, with a habit of checking your own bias.
* Daily professional use of AI to query data and build tools, and a working knowledge of where it fails.
* Fluency in Excel or Google Sheets, and comfort moving through internal systems to assemble facts.
* Experience tracking and reporting operational metrics, and judgment about which ones mislead.
* Ownership of each case until the underlying problem is solved.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* SQL, Python (Pandas), or a BI tool such as Looker or Tableau.
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or Replit, or with no-code tools such as Zapier.
* Experience working with external stakeholders such as clients, legal teams, or law enforcement.
* Experience testing or launching product features.
* Background in a marketplace or labor platform.

#LI-Onsite

**Our Values**

* **Empathy, Trust & Candor**  
  We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* **Bias for Action**  
  We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* **Always Be Learning**  
  We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* **Act Like an Owner**  
  We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**

Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!

Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.

Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs
