jobs.title: Pharmacy Operations Optimization Manager – KitCheck
jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

The Pharmacy Operations Optimization Manager is responsible for the engagement health and realized value of Bluesight's KitCheck customer portfolio. KitCheck helps hospital pharmacies process kits and trays faster and more accurately with RFID, but the product only delivers value when pharmacy teams actively scan, keep their formulary and kit masters current, stay ahead on tag and consumable ordering, and use the data to run leaner operations. This role exists to make sure that happens across every account, not just the ones that ask for help.

You will own the full book of business at the cohort level: monitoring engagement and operational performance across all KitCheck customers, identifying accounts drifting toward disengagement before they become renewal risks, and directing the right resource (yourself, an Implementation or Support specialist, or a Customer Success Manager) to get them back on track. You will also build and run the reporting cadence that keeps our internal teams aligned, including a recurring executive summary and regular updates to CSMs on their accounts.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with hands-on experience in hospital pharmacy operations, ideally including kit and tray processing, medication inventory management, or pharmacy automation. A PharmD or CPhT credential is required. You can balance portfolio-level oversight with hands-on customer work, and you are comfortable being the subject matter expert in the room with a pharmacy director, an operations manager, or a buyer.

### **Core Responsibilities**

**Portfolio & Cohort Management:** Own engagement health across the full KitCheck customer base. Maintain a portfolio view of which accounts are actively working the product, which are drifting, and which need intervention, and make sure every at-risk account has a named owner and a plan.

**Engagement Metrics & Reporting:** Define and maintain the KitCheck engagement scorecard (e.g., scanning and kit processing activity, charge and restock turnaround, tag and consumable ordering trends, expired medication capture, active user trends). Publish a recurring executive flash summarizing portfolio health, and send regular account-level updates to CSMs so nothing surprises them at renewal.

**Proactive Account Intervention:** For accounts missing the mark, run the play: diagnose the gap, re-engage the customer directly or deploy the right internal expert, and establish recurring touchpoints (monthly calls, best-practice reviews) until the account is back on track.

**SME Capacity Orchestration:** Direct traffic for pharmacy SME capacity across Implementation, Support, and Professional Services. Proactively scope and assign timeboxed engagements (workflow reviews, kit master cleanups, operational tune-ups, re-training) against the accounts that need them most, alongside the existing CSM-initiated request channel.

**CS & Sales Enablement:** Arm CSMs and Account Managers with engagement and adoption context ahead of QBRs, EBRs, and renewal conversations. Flag accounts that are healthy enough for expansion conversations, and be honest about the ones that are not.

**Best Practices & Thought Leadership:** Develop and maintain the KitCheck Engagement Playbook covering cadences, intervention plays, and communication templates. Lead webinars and customer-facing content that raise the bar on pharmacy operations maturity across the customer base.

**Voice of the Customer:** Represent pharmacy workflow challenges, hardware and consumable friction, and adoption gaps to Product, Engineering, and Supply Chain, particularly where they affect renewal or expansion risk.

### **Qualifications**

**Education & Credentials**

* Bachelor's degree in pharmacy or a related field, or equivalent pharmacy technician experience.
* PharmD or CPhT credential required. Involvement in pharmacy practice communities (e.g., ASHP) is a plus.

**Experience**

* 5+ years in hospital pharmacy operations, including medication inventory management, kit and tray workflows, or pharmacy automation.
* Direct experience running or improving pharmacy operational workflows such as crash cart and tray processing, expiration management, and restocking cadences.
* Familiarity with RFID medication tracking, automated dispensing cabinets, and pharmacy information systems preferred.
* Experience in customer engagement, account management, or implementation within healthcare or hospital systems.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Proven ability to build credible relationships with pharmacy directors, operations managers, and technicians while delivering measurable value.
* Strong data analysis skills: comfortable defining metrics, reading engagement dashboards, and turning trends into intervention plans.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills for both customer-facing and executive audiences.
* Ability to manage a portfolio of accounts and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.

### **Why Join Us**

Hospital pharmacies are asked to do more with less every year, and manual kit and tray processing wastes pharmacist and technician hours that patients need elsewhere. In this role you will directly raise the operational effectiveness of medication kit management across a national portfolio of health systems while shaping how Bluesight scales proactive customer engagement across its product lines. You will work alongside experienced Implementation and Support teams, an established Customer Success organization, and a proven engagement playbook alr

**Organization Overview**

The Ehlers-Danlos Society is dedicated to improving the lives of people affected by Ehlers-Danlos syndromes (EDS) and hypermobility spectrum disorders (HSD). Through research, education, and collaboration, we work to accelerate diagnosis, improve access to effective clinical care and management, and accelerate the development of dedicated therapeutic treatments.

The EDS ECHO Manager leads the day-to-day delivery of EDS ECHO, with line management responsibility for the EDS ECHO team and accountability for the program’s operational and administrative functions.

The role provides project management and oversight of program governance, supporting quality, sustainability, and progress against agreed targets.

Through this work, the Manager ensures that EDS ECHO contributes to The Society’s work to address the most pressing challenges affecting people with EDS and HSD by accelerating diagnosis, driving the development of treatments and therapies, advancing access to care, and educating and connecting the community.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Human Evaluations (Recommendations)
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

**Job Description**

Great recommendations are how members find something worth their time. We are looking for an experienced Human Evaluations Program Manager to help us measure and improve the quality of recommendations across the Netflix homepage and discovery experience. You will work alongside Product Management and ML teams to build the human evaluation programs that tell us whether recommendations are working for members, and where they are not.

**About the Role**

Netflix is building toward more relevant, more varied, and more trustworthy recommendations, and thoughtful, high-quality evaluation is essential to making sure we are moving in the right direction. Join a team creating the frameworks, tools, and workflows that ensure human judgment is applied with consistency, clarity, and care, whether we are evaluating relevance, repetition, diversity, or whether a recommendation simply makes sense to the member.

You will not only shape how human evaluations of our recommendations are designed, but also own the day-to-day execution. From scoping and planning to vendor management, rater onboarding, and calibration, you will be accountable for driving delivery from start to finish. Just as critically, you will act as a thought partner to Product Management, helping translate recommendation strategy into evaluation designs and building a shared language around recommendation quality across teams.

**The Opportunity**

In this role, you will partner across product, research, data science, UX, and engineering to develop rubrics, frameworks, and workflows that enable rigorous, scalable human evaluation of recommendations. Beyond shaping the "what" and "how," you will also lead the "when" and "done." You will keep evaluation projects on track, ensuring consistent execution, timely delivery, efficient use of vendor capacity, and high rater alignment. If you are excited to bring structure to ambiguity and influence what members see when they open Netflix, while being accountable for tangible delivery, this is your chance to create meaningful impact from day one.

**The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of structure and flexibility. You know how to create evaluation frameworks that are rigorous and scalable, and you are also a driver who gets them out the door. You are skilled at translating product strategy into evaluation workflows, defining milestones, managing vendors, and delivering consistent results in a dynamic environment. You can steer teams across functions, keep timelines on track, and ensure rater quality without micromanaging. You are curious about how personalization works and can build credibility with PMs, data scientists, and ML engineers. You have working fluency in film and TV content and can quickly scan a set of titles to tell whether they belong together. You thrive in spaces where there is no roadmap, and you take pride in making things real, not just possible.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end execution of human evaluation and data operations initiatives, from intake and scoping to delivery
* Partner with Product Management to translate recommendation strategy and roadmap priorities into evaluation designs, success metrics, and timelines
* Manage human annotation vendors, including capacity planning, SLAs, quality performance, and escalations
* Drive operational efficiency across evaluation programs, including cost per task, throughput, turnaround time, and speed to IRR
* Develop clear, scalable guidelines and scoring rubrics to ensure consistent rater judgment, including for subjective, taste-based questions
* Oversee rater onboarding, calibration, and QA workflows
* Pilot and refine evaluation tasks to improve clarity, inter-rater reliability, and feedback quality
* Anticipate and resolve bottlenecks and blockers
Act as the connective tissue across product, ML, data science, and vendor partners to ensure alignment and effective execution of evaluations at scale  

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience working in human evaluations, data collection, labeling, or annotation operations in ML environments
* Track record of implementing process improvements or quality control systems for data collection needs
* Prior experience managing human annotation vendors, raters, or data labeling teams, including vendor performance and cost management
* Experience improving operational efficiency of annotation programs (throughput, turnaround, cost)
* Strong understanding of evaluation design, including guidelines, rubrics, and scoring protocols
* Working fluency in film and TV content, including genres, formats, and talent
* Proven ability in end-to-end management of complex, cross-functional programs, demonstrating strong Program Management skills and clear accountability for successful delivery
* Experience with human labeling platforms
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to synthesize feedback into clear recommendations and process improvements
* Familiarity with how rater subjectivity and bias affect taste-based judgments, and how to account for them in evaluation design
Strong organizational skills and executional focus; ability to track details while seeing the bigger picture  

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with personalization, recommender systems, search, or ranking evaluation
* Familiarity with how offline human evaluation complements online experimentation (A/B tests) and engagement metrics
* Experience evaluating at the list or page level, not only the individual item level
* Experience partnering with Product Managers and Dat

**Hy-Tek Intralogistics**

**Job Description**

**Job Title:** Senior Project Manager

**Department:** Project Management

**Supervisor:** Manager, Project Management

**Job Purpose:**

Working in partnership with key internal, external, and executive stakeholders, this position oversees high-priority projects, which often require considerable resources and complex hardware and software integrations. The position interfaces with all areas affected by the project, including end users, distributors, and vendors; it also ensures adherence to quality standards and reviews project deliverables.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Act as the point person for client communications during implementation.
* Manages the project schedule using the recommended project management tools and processes to drive completion within the agreed timeline.
* Manages scope of project to ensure that the project includes all the work required and only the work required to complete the project successfully.
* Utilize change management in accordance with established business processes.
* Develops resource plans to manage resources effectively. Maintain project budgets and a detailed project cost variance report.
* Manages the project to identify, assess and prioritize issues and risks to minimize, monitor, and control the probability and/or impact of negative events or to maximize the realization of positive events.
* Build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions.
* Interpret and apply understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions. Track invoice dates and proactively communicate changes/updates.
* Ascertain complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* Plan and prioritize work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.
* Handle conflict situations effectively to minimize recourse.
* Develop and deliver communications with cross-functional and diverse teams effectively to meet project objectives to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
* Organize and conduct weekly status meetings along with generating weekly status reports.
* Manage legal aspects of the project, with support of legal team, including subcontractor agreements, permit applications, and site inspections.
* Oversee daily activities of subcontractors during contract implementation. Ensure contractors follow industry standards for workmanship.

* Experience in planning, managing, and executing basic, medium, and complex material handling projects is preferred.

* Excellent problem solving, judgment making, and organizational skills.
* Advanced experience in planning, managing, and executing basic, medium, and complex material handling projects is preferred.
* Ability to work without direct supervision with a high degree of responsibility.
* Well-developed verbal/interpersonal skills with strong organizational, problem solving and time management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and comfortably in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent organization, priority setting, and project management skills with experience managing multiple projects concurrently.
* Ability to communicate with internal team members and drive changes or decisions necessary for project implementation.
* Ability to understand mechanical and electrical drawings with assistance from engineering.
* Excellent understanding and adherence to change management business processes.
* AutoCAD viewer & Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Teams, SharePoint) experience preferred.

**Move Security Forward with Acre**  
Are you passionate about transforming the future of security? Do you thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment where your contributions drive real impact? If so, Acre Security is the place for you. Join us in making the world a safer place — one innovation at a time.  
  
**About Acre**  
At Acre, we're not just building security solutions — we’re empowering security professionals to adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing world. Since our inception in 2012, Acre has been at the forefront of innovation in access control, visitor management, and intrusion software. Our solutions are trusted by organizations in over 25 countries, delivering smarter, more adaptable, and easier-to-use security technologies that protect what matters most.

We're looking for an **Agile Project Manager** to join our **Project Management** team. You will own end-to-end delivery of our visitor management, access control, and intrusion products, from requirements through release. You'll coordinate across R&D, engineering, product management, supply chain, compliance, and third-party partners. IMC Designs operates in the advertising specialties and promotional products industry, helping businesses promote their brands through customized merchandise and branded products. Promotional merchandise can support corporate marketing campaigns, customer appreciation programs, employee recognition initiatives, trade shows, business events, and other brand-building activities.

Coordinating these services requires accurate product information, organized customer orders, timely communication, supplier coordination, and careful attention to customization requirements and delivery schedules.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Promotional Products Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day coordination of promotional product orders, supplier communications, order documentation, and customer requirements. This role designs, implements, and enhances quality processes with a strong focus on Balto, leveraging its agent-assist tools, playbook development, and automated-scoring capabilities to improve real-time performance.
  
  
Acting as a strategic partner to Contact Center Supervisors, the Quality Enablement Partner provides insights, frameworks, and tools that empower teams to deliver high-quality service. This is a strategic and tactical enablement position dedicated to ensuring agents have the guidance, support, and feedback needed to succeed. As a quality subject matter expert, the Quality Enablement Partner collaborates closely with operational leaders to strengthen coaching effectiveness, calibration consistency, and data-driven decision-making that elevate overall performance.

* Partners with agents and supervisors to identify opportunities for real-time guidance that enhances support outcomes and customer experience.
* Manages and continuously refines artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled quality-scoring processes, ensuring accuracy, fairness, and alignment with evolving business needs.
* Tracks and reports the impact of Balto and quality initiatives on customer satisfaction, compliance, and agent performance.
* Develops and maintains quality scorecards, rubrics, and reporting frameworks that integrate AI insights with traditional quality-assurance (QA) methods.
* Equips supervisors with clear, actionable quality insights to improve coaching effectiveness and team performance.
* Acts as a peer consultant and strategic partner to Supervisors, jointly accountable for achieving cohort-level quality results.
* Facilitates calibration sessions and feedback loops to drive consistency, transparency, and shared learning across teams.
* Supports supervisors in delivering effective, consistent coaching by providing frameworks and resources that build confidence and alignment.
* Analyzes quality trends and agent feedback to identify performance barriers and recommend process improvements.
* Collaborates with Operational Excellence teams to address skill gaps, refine processes, and elevate coaching standards.
* Champions a culture of continuous improvement, leveraging data and technology to enhance both the agent and customer experience.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**What You Will Bring:**  

* A high school diploma or equivalent is required.
* A minimum of three (3) years of experience in contact center quality assurance, operations, training, or performance management is required.
* Direct experience implementing and managing Balto or similar real-time conversation-guidance or agent-assist platforms.
* Hands-on experience with speech analytics, playbook design, AI-driven quality-assurance processes, and automated scoring.
* Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work as a peer partner with supervisors and agents.
* Strong analytical and storytelling skills, with the ability to analyze data, interpret trends, and translate quality metrics into compelling narratives and actionable plans.
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence without authority.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
* High emotional intelligence and empathy for agents and leadership stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, data-visualization tools, and performance-tracking systems.
* Strong alignment with organizational values and a commitment to continuous improvement.
* Excellent presentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to guide and support others through collaboration, including assisting teammates and contributing to shared processes, to foster a high-quality, team-oriented environment that drives results.
* Self-starter with strong organizational and time-management skills, self-directed and able to handle multiple priorities with demanding timeframes.

Atlas Healthcare Partners exists to form strategic partnerships with health systems across the nation to develop, manage and operate Ambulatory Surgery Centers (ASCs) in their markets. As a key player in this rapidly growing healthcare segment, we are committed to providing exceptional care and outstanding customer service to every patient, every physician, every time. Our daily focus revolves around our core values of Integrity, Culture, Teamwork, Respect, and Results.
  
In addition to fostering a workplace that encourages professional growth and advancement, we provide industry-leading health and dental benefits, paired with a matching retirement package. We look forward to you being a vital part of our journey in shaping the future of healthcare.
  
  
POSITION SUMMARY
  
This position leads a team, or teams, within the Revenue Cycle organization that coordinates and facilitates financial clearing patients prior to surgery including building estimates, taking patient phone calls, following up on authorizations and collecting funds prior to service.
  
  
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  

* Confirm valid coverage for services and location by contacting insurance companies and/or review electronic responses for benefit information.
* Manage patient insurance demographic information to verify authorization obligations.
* Verify that service is a covered benefit, based on knowledge of the specific insurance plan, the specific benefit package restrictions, and the timing of the service.
* Understand patient deductibles, out-of-network referrals and out-of-pocket limitations.
* Review the account and timing of last patient demographic query to identify missing standard and/or required information. If necessary, contact the patient to complete the information.
* Calculate and collect patient liability before or at the time of service. Communicate the liability and explain the calculation low and high amounts when necessary.
* Identify the potential need for assistance when the coverage/benefit is either inadequate or nonexistent for a medically necessary service, and if necessary, create a payment plan with the patient and document the agreement appropriately.

* Provides all customers with an excellent service experience by consistently demonstrating our core and leader behaviors each and every day.

**NOTE:** The essential functions are intended to describe the general content of and requirements of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. Specific tasks or responsibilities will be documented as outlined by the incumbent's immediate manager.
  
  
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Bachelor’s Degree or seven years of healthcare insurance and patient accounts experience.
* Requires knowledge of patient financial services, financial, collecting services, or insurance industry experience processes normally acquired over one or more years of work experience.
* Requires the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously with minimal supervision and to work independently.
* Requires strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills to effectively interact with a wide range of audiences.
* Strong knowledge in the use of common office software, word processing, spreadsheet, and database software are required.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) may be required based on market(s) assignment. Must be able to speak, read, and communicate fluently in Spanish to support patient financial counseling, benefit explanation, and pre service communication.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Work experience with HST Pathways, Mnet, and Waystar systems is preferred.
* Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

* Focus on creating and maintaining procedures that align with a high standard of compliance and internal control.
* Working knowledge of patient accounting and experience reconciling AR accounts

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Care Navigator  
**Job Location:** Remote - Mountain time zone - patients located in Mountain time  
  
**Applicants must be comfortable working 7a-4p MST**

**Company Description:**

Greater Good Health is a fast-growing organization delivering care to older adults in access starved communities. Our innovative model is led by Nurse Practitioners and focused on outcomes, not volume—meaning we prioritize quality over quantity, spend more time with our patients, and are accountable for their health and well-being.
  
  
Whether through our own senior-focused primary care clinics or our suite of integrated clinical solutions for health plans and provider groups, we are making value-based care more accessible and more effective. We help reduce avoidable healthcare costs, improve clinical outcomes, and create a best-in-class patient experience.

If you're passionate about transforming healthcare and delivering meaningful care to those who need it most, Greater Good Health offers a purpose-driven, collaborative, and supportive environment where your work can make a lasting impact.

**Typical Duties**  
**Patient Outreach & Engagement**

* Conduct proactive outreach to schedule patient home, telehealth, and in-clinic visits to complete Annual Wellness Visits (AWVs), ensuring patients receive timely preventative care and individualized care plans.
* Accept inbound calls from patients to schedule AWVs and address care-related questions or concerns.
* Connect with the geriatric population to build trusting, long-term relationships — making patients feel calm, comfortable, and heard throughout their care experience.
* Identify and address barriers to engagement, including transportation, language, health literacy, financial hardship, and other social and environmental factors.
* Outreach to patients to complete key preventative screenings (colon cancer, mammograms, diabetic retina scans, HbA1c, and more), documenting outreach and establishing follow-through plans.

**Care Coordination & Panel Management**

* Partner closely with assigned GGH Nurse Practitioners (NPs) to co-manage their patient panel, serving as the day-to-day coordination hub for scheduling, care follow-through, and patient communication.
* Build and optimize driving routes for GGH Nurse Practitioners completing home visits, maximizing time spent with patients.
* Coordinate patient cancellations, reschedules, and add-on visits with the NP to ensure continuity of care and efficient schedule management.
* Retrieve and reconcile medical records from outside providers, hospitals, health systems, and community organizations to ensure the care team has a complete and current view of each patient’s health history.
* Manage patients post-discharge from hospital or skilled nursing facility settings, coordinating timely follow-up visits and facilitating care plan transitions to reduce readmission risk.
* Follow up with patients on outstanding provider orders — including lab work, imaging, specialist referrals, and durable medical equipment — ensuring completion and routing results back to the care team.
* Coordinate referrals and activities for high-risk programs, facilitating smooth transitions between care settings and service providers.
* Support the care team in identifying and closing quality gaps, including HEDIS measures and chronic disease management needs.

**Compliance & Documentation**

* Handle protected health information (PHI) with discretion, adhering to HIPAA standards and GGH privacy policies at all times.
* Maintain timely, accurate, and thorough documentation of all patient interactions, outreach attempts, care coordination activities, and follow-up plans.

**Collaboration & Program Development**

* Build strong, positive working relationships with GGH Nurse Practitioners and the Patient Outreach Team, and maintain professional communications with client partners and the broader care team.
* Participate in interdisciplinary care team meetings, contributing patient updates and coordinating action steps across team members.
* Maintain collaborative relationships with clinicians and the leadership team to support the development of new programs aimed at improving patient engagement, care coordination, and health outcomes.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Key Success Outcomes**

* Completing 50–100 outbound calls per day.
* Achieving conversion rate expectations for AWV scheduling and preventative care outreach.
* Successfully managing post-discharge follow-up to minimize care gaps and reduce avoidable readmissions.
* Timely retrieval and reconciliation of outside medical records to support care team decision-making.
* High completion rates on outstanding provider orders through consistent, proactive patient follow-up.
* Building and maintaining strong professional relationships with the Care Navigator team and GGH Nurse Practitioners.
* Timely, accurate, and thorough documentation in all systems of record.
* Meeting and exceeding call quality standards.

**Requirements**

* 1–2 years of post-high school education or an associate’s degree; bachelor’s degree in health sciences, social work, public health, or a related field is a plus.
* 1–3 years of experience working in standard operating systems (Windows, MS Word, MS Excel, Internet, and other applicable software).
* 1–3 years of experience in a patient-facing healthcare role.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex health information in an accessible and empathetic way.
* Outstanding phone skills with sensitivity toward protected health information (PHI) and HIPAA compliance.
* Familiarity with medical terminology and basic understanding of chronic disease management in older adults.
* Must be organized, detail-oriented, and able to multitask in a fast-paced care coordination environment.
* Must be adaptable, a team player, and comfortable working both independently and collaboratively.
* Professionalism

jobs.description:
The geography covers CA, AZ, NV, AK, and HI. The ideal candidate location would be major metro location in California or Arizona.  
  
***Patient Access Liaison***  
  
**About Krystal Bio:**  
  
At Krystal Biotech, we bring together the brightest and most eager minds to relentlessly pursue the discovery, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of genetic medicines to treat diseases with high unmet medical needs.  
  
Founded in 2016, Krystal is distinguished in three powerful ways: science and technology using our patented gene therapy platform, innovative manufacturing supported by our commercial scale facilities, and a unique commercialization model that focuses on the patient’s end to end experience.  
  
Krystal received U.S. FDA approval for the first and only redosable gene therapy treatment, VYJUVEK®, for the treatment of Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (DEB). Krystal continues to leverage our proprietary platform to rapidly advance a robust pipeline of investigational genetic medicines in respiratory, oncology, dermatology, and ophthalmology.  
  
Krystal is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA which is home to our two state-of-the-art CGMP manufacturing facilities with teams around the world and satellite offices in Switzerland, Germany, and Japan. We are a company built and run by people who care, are fearless in the face of a challenge, love the work they do, and practice the highest level of scientific integrity. As we grow, we are seeking team members that embody these values.  
  
**Job Description Summary:**  
The Patient Access Liaison (PAL) is a field-based position that will provide product reimbursement, distribution, logistical, and other non-medical educational assistance to patients/caregivers as well as HCP office and site of care staff. The PAL will work with the patient and their health care providers to educate them on the requirements to gain access to therapy including information specific to prior authorization and appeals. The PAL will also work to maintain relationships with the patients and the office staff to support ongoing compliance with prescribed therapy, including as needed collaboration with specialty pharmacy and distributors.  
  
The PAL is a highly visible position and will have an assigned geographic region and requires strong teamwork to provide exceptional customer service to patients, caregivers, HCP staff as well as internal cross-functional teams. The Patient Access Liaisons must have experience in rare diseases including strong knowledge of reimbursement and distribution for buy & bill/medical benefit covered products.  
  
**Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following:**

* Support patients with accessing treatment by educating the patient & office staff about payer access & insurance processes, including specific payer requirements for authorization.
* Assist patients & office staff with finding sites of care options closer to their home and options for home dosing.
* Ability to navigate office and SOC staff to identify the appropriate personnel who support the patient with coverage and access needs.
* Provide education on affordability assistance options including copay assistance, patient assistance programs (PAP), and other alternative options.
* Provide non-medical, educational support including what to expect when initiating therapy.
* Prepare patients and help coordinate the next appointment and treatment.
* Develop trusted relationships with patients and caregivers by engaging via phone, text, email, virtual or in person connections.
* Follow a planned educational and support program to support patients on therapy to optimize adherence to the prescribed therapy.
* Provide proactive education to large centers, community prescribers and sites of care, product procurement options and associated billing and coding requirements for product and professional services.
* Work compliantly within the Krystal patient CRM/Workflow system to document case progress, complete assigned tasks, and overall case management functions with PAL responsibilities.
* Other duties as assigned

**Requirements and Preferred Qualifications:**

* BS/BA degree required
* 5+ years of experience (Field-Based Preferred) in patient services, field reimbursement, biopharma sales or account management required with a minimum of 1 year working directly with patients/families providing education and access support.
* Scientific background and ability to learn product and disease information.
* Orphan or Rare disease experience working directly with patients/caregivers.
* Familiarity with HIPAA guidelines and FDA regulations.
* Ability to travel between 30%-50%.
* Ability to handle difficult patient cases and resolve hurdles.
* Ability to work in team environment and manage communication and provide appropriate leadership with internal team members, specialty pharmacy partners, and field sales.
* Ability to respond immediately, when necessary (within 24 hours), to prevent lapses in treatment.
* Previous experience with Patient Journey Navigator (PJN) preferred for patient services and case management workflow preferred.

jobs.title: Program Lead
jobs.description:
**About Trauma Healing Accelerated**

Trauma Healing Accelerated (THA) is an education organization built on the Biology of Trauma® framework developed by Dr. Aimie Apigian, a double board-certified physician and author of *The Biology of Trauma*. The framework explains how unresolved trauma is held in the body and nervous system, and how it can be addressed through a biology-first approach.

THA serves two audiences: individuals pursuing their own healing, and the coaches, therapists and clinicians who support them. Our programs include the self-paced 21-Day Journey, our flagship Foundational Journey, the Biology of Trauma® modules, yearlong programs for individuals and practitioners, and an online member community. All THA offerings are educational in nature and do not constitute medical advice.

* Position: Program Lead
* Location: Remote (team operates on Pacific Time)
* Reports to: Executive Director of Programs
* Key relationship: Dr. Aimie Apigian, Founder
* Employment type: Contract, full-time hours

**Position overview**

The Program Lead is accountable for the delivery and quality of every THA program and for the participant experience from enrollment through completion. The role leads the program management and support team, establishes delivery standards, and ensures participants complete their programs and progress to the next appropriate offering.

This is a systems-oriented leadership position. The Program Lead anticipates issues before they affect participants, resolves their root causes through improved processes, and protects the founder's time for teaching and content. The role relies on AI tools and automated systems to run repeatable program cycles, monitor participant engagement and keep a small team operating at scale.

**Key responsibilities**

**Program delivery**

* Oversee the delivery of all THA programs, including the 21-Day Journey, the Foundational Journey, the Biology of Trauma® modules and the yearlong programs for individuals and practitioners.
* Develop cohort calendars and schedules for live sessions, Q&A sessions and group coaching well in advance, ensuring every launch is fully prepared on schedule.
* Conduct a full participant-perspective review of each program before it opens, verifying links, communications, course pages, recordings and access.

**Participant experience**

* Own the participant journey from enrollment and onboarding through completion and graduation.
* Monitor engagement and completion, and intervene early when participants disengage.
* Translate participant feedback, survey results and support trends into improvements to programs and supporting processes.
* Oversee the online member community and all participant-facing program communications, ensuring consistency with the founder's voice.

**Continuation and retention**

* Guide graduates toward the most appropriate next program, in coordination with the growth team on timing and messaging.
* Own renewal and retention strategy for the yearlong programs and the practitioner network.

**Team leadership and operations**

* Lead the program managers, live session hosts, mentors and support staff responsible for program delivery.
* Develop and maintain the standard operating procedures, checklists and project management systems the team relies on.
* Establish a consistent weekly operating rhythm with clear priorities, ownership and status visibility.
* Identify and resolve quality issues before they reach the founder, and present decisions to her with options and a recommendation.

**AI and automation**

* Use AI tools such as Claude daily to draft participant communications, summarize feedback and support trends, and prepare session briefs for the founder.
* Build and maintain automated workflows for enrollment, onboarding, reminders, launch checklists and recurring program tasks.
* Turn program launches and cohort cycles into templated, automated processes that run predictably without manual rebuilding.
* Use automated reporting to track completion, engagement and continuation, and flag participants who need attention.
* Partner with THA's AI and web systems specialist to identify new opportunities to automate repetitive work, and review AI-generated content for accuracy before it reaches participants.

**Key performance indicators**

Performance in this role is measured by participant outcomes, satisfaction and retention.

* Completion rates for each program
* Continuation from the Foundational Journey into modules and yearlong programs
* Renewal and retention rates for the yearlong programs and practitioner network
* Participant satisfaction scores and reduction in avoidable support requests
* On-time launches and cohort starts free of access, link or communication errors
* A team that operates its responsibilities independently, reducing escalations to the founder

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Demonstrated experience managing online programs, courses, cohorts or membership communities.
* Experience leading distributed teams across countries and time zones.
* Advanced, hands-on proficiency with AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for operations, communications and analysis, with examples of how AI improved efficiency or results.
* Experience building or managing automations and integrated systems, such as course platform workflows, email and SMS automation, or no-code tools like Zapier or n8n.
* A strong systems orientation, with experience developing SOPs, project management structures and operating rhythms that scale beyond any one individual.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a rigorous approach to quality assurance.
* Clear, compassionate communication with participants and team members, including in sensitive situations.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to act on completion, continuation and retention data.

No prior experience with THA programs is necessary.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your resume and a brief summary of a program or tea

jobs.description:
**Remedio is transforming how organizations reduce cyber risk.**

While most security tools focus on finding problems, Remedio focuses on fixing them.

Our Autonomous Remediation Platform helps enterprises continuously and safely reduce exposure by remediating vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, closing patching gaps, hardening systems, enforcing compliance, governing applications, and controlling AI risk.

By combining deep dependency awareness, pre-execution validation, automated remediation, and instant rollback, Remedio enables organizations to eliminate risk across endpoints, servers, applications, and AI systems - without disrupting business operations.

Founded in 2019, Remedio spent its first years as a bootstrapped, profitable company, building a strong enterprise customer base before raising a $65M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners.

Today, more than 300 enterprise organizations trust Remedio to protect over 3M devices worldwide, including Amazon, Colgate-Palmolive, Kansas Health, Coca-Cola, and many more.

As we continue expanding our platform and growing our global business, we're looking for exceptional people who want to take ownership, solve meaningful challenges, and help shape the next chapter of Remedio's journey.

  
Requirements:
  

* 4+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Renewals at a B2B SaaS company, with a book you owned and a retention or expansion number you hit.

* The ability to run a high-volume book: you prioritize by risk and opportunity, keep a tight cadence, and keep many renewals moving at once.
* Commercial instincts: you can negotiate a renewal, handle pricing objections, and qualify an expansion.
* Enough technical depth to earn credibility with IT and security practitioners, and the clarity to explain value to their leadership.
* CRM discipline and comfort working from data.
* A startup or high-growth mindset: urgency, self-direction, and energy for building something new.

**Nice to have**

* You've worked at an endpoint, vulnerability, or exposure management vendor.
* You've used a structured qualification method (we use MEDDPICC).
* You've managed renewals that run through resellers or channel partners.
* You use AI tools to run your book and want to help shape how we use them.
* You hold a security or IT certification.

  
Responsibilities:  
  

Location: Remote | Reports to: Director, Customer Success | Travel: up to 10%

**Remedio** is growing fast, and we're adding a **Customer Success Manager** to own a portfolio of commercial and small enterprise customers across the US.

Our customers bought Remedio to fix risk, not just report on it.

Your job is to make sure they do: get them deployed, get the right capabilities running, show them the exposure they've eliminated, and turn that value into renewals and growth. Finding problems is easy. Proving they got fixed is what keeps a customer.

You'll own the full post-sale relationship for your book, from onboarding through adoption, renewal, and expansion. You'll work alongside Technical Account Managers, Sales, and Solutions Engineering, with a CS leadership team building the playbooks, signals, and tooling that help you run a high-velocity book well.

If you want real ownership, a clear number, and a hand in shaping how a growing CS team operates, come join us.

**What you'll do**

* **Own your book.** Be the primary point of contact for your customers, with a clear view of each account's stakeholders, what they bought, and what success looks like for them.
* **Get customers to value fast.** Drive onboarding and deployment, get purchased capabilities live, and remove the blockers between signature and measurable risk reduction.
* **Renew early and on time.** Start renewal conversations 180 days out so there's time to understand what's changed for the customer and work through concerns before you're up against a deadline.
* **Grow your accounts.** Find and qualify expansion across devices and the wider platform, including patching, vulnerability remediation, hardening, compliance, application governance, and AI risk. Partner with Sales to close it.
* **Act on signals, not guesses.** Use license, product usage, and customer sentiment signals to spot risk and opportunity early, then act on them with a clear plan.
* **Run business reviews that prove value.** Show customers, in their own numbers, the exposure Remedio has eliminated and the time their teams got back.
* **Forecast with confidence.** Keep the CRM current, stage and tag your renewals and expansion accurately, call your number, and flag risk early.
* **Be the voice of the customer.** Capture feature requests and bugs tied to the business outcome behind them, route them through our product process, and turn happy customers into references, reviews, and advocates.

**How we measure success**

We measure Customer Success on outcomes.

You'll be accountable for gross revenue retention (GRR), net revenue retention (NRR), and the share of your renewals closed early.

Together they show whether customers got value, stayed, and grew.

**﻿What your first 90 days looks like**

We'll set you up with a clear path and the support to follow it:

* **First 30 days:** get up to speed on the platform, our buyers, and our renewal playbook. Meet every customer in your book and build an account plan for each renewal in the next two quarters.
* **First 90 days:** own your forecast, with renewals staged and on track, adoption plans running for your lowest-adopting accounts, your first business reviews delivered, and your first expansion opportunity qualified.

**Travel**

Travel is up to 10%, roughly 5 to 6 trips a year, and centers on the events where your customers are.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About HappyRobot  
  
HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

The Role  
  
As a Customer Success Manager, you will own the post-sale relationship with a portfolio of large, enterprise customers. You will make sure each customer sees real, measurable value from their AI workforce, and then help them expand it to new workflows, teams, and regions. You will work side by side with our forward-deployed engineers, deployment strategists, and account executives, and you will be the voice of the customer inside HappyRobot.  
This is a strategic role, not a support role. Our customers are adopting a new kind of technology, and you will guide them from first deployment to a fully scaled AI operation. We are especially interested in candidates with a logistics background who can earn the trust of large, complex organizations and speak the language of their operations teams.  
  
What You Will Do

* Own a portfolio of large enterprise accounts and act as the primary day-to-day and executive-level contact.
* Drive adoption and time-to-value by defining success metrics with each customer, such as resolution time, load coverage, calls automated, and cost savings.
* Run regular business reviews that translate performance data into clear business outcomes and next steps.
* Identify and lead expansion opportunities into new use cases, business units, and geographies, partnering closely with Sales.
* Partner with forward-deployed engineers and deployment strategists to scope, launch, and iterate on new workflows.
* Monitor account health, anticipate risk, and lead renewals with a clear view of value delivered.
* Capture customer feedback and turn it into actionable input for Product and Engineering.
* Build repeatable playbooks, onboarding materials, and best practices as the Customer Success function scales.

What You Bring

* 4 to 7 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS or technology company, with experience managing enterprise accounts.
* **Preferred:** Hands-on logistics, freight, or supply chain experience (for example at a freight broker, 3PL, carrier, shipper, or logistics technology company), ideally managing large, multi-stakeholder accounts.
* A track record of driving adoption, retention, and expansion, with comfort owning renewal and growth targets.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate with both operators on the floor and C-level stakeholders.
* Comfort with data. You can read usage and performance metrics, build a clear narrative around them, and recommend next steps.
* Technical curiosity. You do not need to code, but you should be comfortable discussing integrations, APIs, workflows, and AI concepts with customers and engineers.
* A bias for ownership and speed, with the ability to thrive in ambiguity at a fast-growing startup.

Nice to Have

* Experience with AI, automation, or voice products.
* Familiarity with TMS, WMS, or CRM systems.
* Spanish, Portuguese, or another language, given our LatAm and international customer base.
* Prior experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup.

Why Join Us

* Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
* Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital, and Eurazeo.
* Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
* Comprehensive benefits including healthcare, dental, and vision coverage.
* Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles  
  
**Extreme Ownership**  
We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting. If something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it is not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We do not wait for someone else to solve it. We lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

**Craftsmanship**  
Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping outcomes by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build, even when nobody is watching.

**We are “majos”**  
Be friendly and have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine and honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

**Urgency with Focus**  
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We are running a high-speed marathon, not a sprint with no strategy.

**Talent Density and Meritocracy**  
Hire only people who can raise the average; exceptional performance is the passing grade. Ability trumps seniority. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure.

**First-Principles Thinking**  
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, and rebuild the solution from scratch. We do not copy-paste solutions.

Compensation Range: $120K - $180K

jobs.title: Video Account Manager
jobs.description:
#### **Description**

Rankings.io is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and client-focused Video Account Manager to join our growing Video Department.

In this role, you'll serve as a key point of contact for clients, ensuring a seamless experience from onboarding through content production, approvals, publishing, and ongoing account management. You'll work closely with our internal video production, creative, and advertising teams to keep projects moving, deadlines on track, and clients informed every step of the way.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates with confidence, and doesn't wait to be told what needs to happen next. You should be comfortable managing multiple client accounts, juggling competing priorities, and following through until the job is done.

#### **Responsibilities**

**Client Onboarding & Account Setup**

* Own the client onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and professional experience from day one.
* Coordinate welcome calls, account connection meetings, and onboarding follow-ups.
* Communicate onboarding requirements, next steps, and outstanding action items to clients.
* Set up and maintain client accounts, project boards, and communication channels in ClickUp and Slack.
* Coordinate account connections, securely manage client-provided credentials, and prepare standardized AI prompt documents.
* Ensure all onboarding requirements are completed before video content is ready for publication.

**Video Content Coordination & Approvals**

* Serve as the primary liaison between clients and internal teams throughout the video content review and approval process.

* Proactively follow up on outstanding feedback, revisions, and approvals to prevent production delays.

* Keep clients informed of publishing timelines and confirm when their content goes live.

**Paid Advertising Coordination**

* Facilitate client review and approval of video advertisements and lead generation forms.
* Track outstanding approvals and follow up to keep advertising campaigns on schedule.
* Communicate campaign launch updates and coordinate post-launch check-in calls.
* Partner with internal advertising teams to ensure client requests, feedback, and next steps are clearly communicated.

**Ongoing Client Account Management**

* Manage day-to-day client communications through Slack, email, and scheduled meetings.
* Build strong client relationships through responsiveness, professionalism, and consistent follow-through.
* Prepare client meeting notes, document action items, and communicate important updates to internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate project timelines, client deliverables, upcoming shoot dates, and account information in ClickUp.
* Proactively identify potential delays, outstanding client needs, and opportunities to improve the client experience.
* Coordinate across departments to ensure client expectations are understood and deliverables remain on track.

**Account Status & Offboarding**

* Maintain accurate client account statuses, including onboarding, active, offboarding, and inactive accounts.
* Coordinate client offboarding requests and communicate necessary next steps to internal teams.
* Track offboarding deliverables and ensure all outstanding requirements are completed.

#### **Requirements**

* Experience in account management, client success, project coordination, or a similar client-facing role.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence communicating directly with clients.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Ability to follow up consistently, manage competing priorities, and keep projects moving without constant oversight.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate client records and project documentation.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with multiple internal stakeholders.
* Experience with project management platforms such as Monday, Asana, ClickUp, or similar tools.
* Proficiency with Slack, email, and virtual meeting platforms.

#### **Nice to Have**

* Experience working at a digital marketing agency, video production company, or creative agency.
* Familiarity with video production workflows, content approval processes, and social media publishing.
* Exposure to paid digital advertising campaigns and lead generation.
* Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Familiarity with the legal marketing industry.

#### **Benefits**

* Salary Range of $60k - $70k
* Fully Remote
* Unlimited PTO
* $100 Wellness Reimbursement Program
* Quarterly training stipend for Professional Development
* 401(k) with 3% Employer match (Safe Harbor)
* 100% Employer-Paid Health Insurance (For Employee)

#### **What to Expect in the Interview Process**

* **Resume Review**: Applications and resumes are reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team.
* **One Way Interview:** Selected candidates will receive a link to answer a short set of questions by video. Please plan to record your responses in your typical work-from-home environment, ensuring it is well-lit and free of distractions.
* **Live Zoom Interview:** Candidates who move forward will meet with Talent Acquisition and the Hiring Manager for a live Zoom interview to discuss experience, role expectations, and team fit.
* **Final Zoom Interview:** Candidates who move forward will meet with Talent Acquisition and Executive Leadership for overall role and culture fit.

=============================

**Remote, United States**

FoodChain ID is looking for a results-driven Strategic Account Manager (SAM) to strengthen and grow relationships with our Mid-Market customers.

In this role, you'll serve as a trusted strategic partner, uncover new business opportunities, and drive revenue growth by connecting customer needs with FoodChain ID's broad portfolio of solutions, including software, data, testing, certification, and regulatory services.

### **What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience in strategic account management, consultative B2B sales, or customer growth.
* Proven success achieving sales quotas and growing existing accounts through cross-selling, upselling, and solution expansion.
* Experience managing complex customer portfolios, renewals, commercial negotiations, and qualified sales pipelines.

### **Why FoodChain ID?**

**WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO:**  
Mosaic Clinical Technologies™ is pioneering a new imaging paradigm—shifting radiology from reactive diagnostics to proactive, decision-driven care. Through our AI-native platform, MosaicOS™, we unite fragmented technologies into a single, intelligent ecosystem designed to help clinical teams work faster, think smarter and deliver better care. Built cloud-native and designed for continuous iteration, MosaicOS™ is engineered to solve the industry’s most pressing challenges. Our platform expands clinical capacity, improves diagnostic quality by combining human expertise with AI, and turns operational complexity into strategic advantage through seamless integration or replacement of legacy imaging systems. Every AI tool within MosaicOS™ is validated across tens of millions of exams to ensure safe, reliable and meaningful clinical impact. With a ransomware-resistant design and built-in redundancy, our platform is designed to ensure continuity of care and protect both patients and operations. Mosaic Clinical Technologies™ is building technology that evolves with clinicians to advance clinical excellence and improve patient outcomes. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of medical imaging, join us!

* Incident Response & Resolution: Independently assess incident severity and clinical impact, troubleshoot Mosaic platform components and integrations, contain issues, and resolve incidents using structured diagnostic methods and AI-assisted tools.

**DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**  

* Technical Support & Incident Response: Experience in technical support, incident response, or IT operations within healthcare IT, clinical technology, or complex SaaS environments.
* Troubleshooting & Independent Judgment: Ability to independently triage and resolve complex, time-sensitive technical issues with incomplete information, using sound judgment when standard procedures are insufficient.
* Clinical Technology Knowledge: Working knowledge of radiology or clinical workflows, with familiarity with PACS, RIS, or similar clinical platforms preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Member Experience (Contract)
jobs.description:
### **Who are we?**

The Motley Fool is a purpose-driven financial services company on a mission to make the world smarter, happier, and richer. For 30 years, we've been helping people make better investment decisions through transparency, education, and a healthy dose of Foolish fun. We're a fast-moving, collaborative team that values high-quality work, curiosity, and initiative. We care deeply about what we do, and we're driven by the impact our work has on real people's financial futures.

### **The Role**

Once someone becomes a Motley Fool member, the product they use every day is what earns their renewal. Our vision moves us from stock picks to a full investing system and platform experience, this role owns building it.

As a Product Manager for Member Experience, you'll own the daily product surface — dashboard, portfolio tools, personalization, and mobile — built on top of the AI scoring and research engine our Intelligence team maintains.

### **What you'll do**

* With your cross-functional team, own member engagement as your core metric, the product-side driver of renewal.
* Anchor the Member Platform team (web and app). You own its backlog and the quality of the member-facing product: dashboard, portfolio tools, community, and mobile app roadmap.
* Own onboarding and activation — get new members to their first valuable action fast, so the value they signed up for lands in the first days, not weeks. This is where early renewal is won or lost.
* Build personalized experiences on top of our AI scoring engine, the right research and insight for the right member, partnering with our Intelligence team, who provide the underlying AI/scoring APIs — keeping personalization on the right side of the line between helpful and regulated investment advice.
* Design and ship features that turn a "read the email" habit into a daily or weekly product habit, across both the in-product and email experience.
* Run a continuous member-research and usage-analytics practice, so decisions are grounded in behavior, not assumption, and feed what you learn into offering and packaging decisions with our commercial and domain experts.
* Write specs precise enough for engineers and AI agents to build against, and bring a business case to our weekly product review. This is a decision-making forum, not a status update.

### **What we're looking for**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally on a consumer or subscription product with a strong engagement/retention focus
* A committed active investor with real skin in the game — you understand our members because you are one
* Experience building personalized or recommendation-driven product experiences is a strong plus
* AI-native working style — comfortable prototyping fast and working alongside AI agents day to day
* A strong product sense for daily-habit, engagement-driven experiences
* Strong stakeholder management — you'll work across engineering, design, and the Intelligence team every week
* Comfortable partnering with other product teams as well as marketing

**Compensation:**

Below is our target hourly rate. While we are budget conscious, we're also eager to find the right person for this role, so if your target is outside of this range, please don't hesitate to apply and we'd be happy to have a conversation.

*By applying on this site, you acknowledge that The Motley Fool will be collecting the personal data you provide for our recruiting purposes. Please see our* *Applicant Privacy Notice* *for additional information about how we process, transfer, and store your data, including where that data is stored, and about any additional privacy rights you may have based on your jurisdiction.*

jobs.title: Food Education Training Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**

FoodCorps is a national nonprofit advancing child well-being through food in school. FoodCorps partners with students, families, and communities to champion nourishing food at local, state, and national levels. Our leaders support schools in providing nutritious meals, locally-informed food education, and welcoming school environments that set kids up for positive, vibrant relationships with food. Building on this program, we develop leaders, grow networks, and advocate for policies in service of every kid’s health and well-being. FoodCorps is working toward a future where all 50 million public school students have access to food education and nourishing meals in school. Learn more at www.foodcorps.org.

**What We Do:**  
Too many children go through the school day without the nutritious food they need to do and feel their best. FoodCorps sets students up for success by working with schools to provide nourishing meals, nutrition education, and community engagement through food. We get kids excited about eating fruits and veggies, support school nutrition staff in bringing locally grown and freshly prepared meals onto lunch trays, and work with families to create positive school food environments for all kids. FoodCorps’ proven programming reaches thousands of students each year, helping to support kids' health, academic progress, and connection to their community through food in school.

jobs.title: Customer Support Lead
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

The owner of customer support end to end, and the person who builds Pocket's community from here. You take support as it stands - team, tooling, metrics, and an AI agent already handling routine volume - and make it yours. Then you take the 100k+ owners who already love Pocket and turn them into a community with a voice and a reason to stay.

Pocket is hardware and software in one product, so support spans both. On support, your priority is automation. On community, you start from exploration - there's already an engaged base across social and comments, and your job is to turn it into advocacy and retention. It's hands-on throughout: you coach the team, you're in the helpdesk config yourself, and you show up for the community.

**What you'll own**

* Automation: the AI support agent, the knowledgebase behind it, and the workflows that keep humans out of routine volume
* The support stack end to end: helpdesk, integrations, routing, and reporting
* A distributed team across time zones, spanning support and community: hiring, coaching, scheduling, performance
* Support quality and SLAs, plus returns, warranty, and order escalations - the realities of a physical product
* The feedback loop: turn what support and community hear into fixes and bets for product and ops
* The core numbers: deflection rate, cost per contact, first-response and resolution time, CSAT - plus community growth and its pull-through to retention

**What we're looking for**

* You've shipped automation in support - automations, AI agents, self-serve - and can point to the numbers moving
* You've run a support team (5+ people) at a consumer company, ideally one with both a hardware and a software product
* Fluent across hardware and software support - you can troubleshoot a device and chase down a sync bug with equal ease, and translate cleanly between customers and engineering on both
* Technically literate - as comfortable configuring a helpdesk or writing a prompt as running a 1:1, and you reach for AI to amplify the team
* You own your metrics and build the systems behind them, end to end, without being managed
* A clear writer who sets the bar for tone - for the team, the AI agent, and every community touchpoint
* Calm under spikes: launches, shipping delays, viral moments, etc.

**What we offer**

* Own a core function
* Direct impact on the experience of thousands of customers
* A high-trust, high-responsibility environment with direct founder access
* Competitive compensation

**About Pocket**
----------------

Pocket is a Y Combinator W26 company building a premium hardware plus software product in the AI voice recorder space. We are obsessed with quality and speed. We are scaling very fast in the US and now European markets and building a device experience that can become the category leader.

Compensation Range: $100K - $180K

### **About Us**

  

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology. We’re building an engaging marketplace where users trade on real-world outcomes - from major sports and elections to cultural and financial events. With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets. OG.com runs on the rails of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (NADEX), a CFTC-regulated exchange operating since 2004 and was acquired by crypto.com in 2022.

### **Role Overview**

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to own how money and identity get into OG: signup, KYC, fiat funding, payouts, and the funding experience behind all of it. Fans can’t trade until they can fund, so every drop-off in onboarding or funding costs us volume, trust, and share of wallet.

Your job is to make funded accounts fast and trustworthy, with a design bar you won’t lower. You’ll own the path from signup through KYC and funding to a trade-ready account: the funding methods that actually clear, the failure states that quietly kill conversion, and the feedback loops that move the funnel. Trading surfaces like markets, parlays, and live sit with a partner PM. The front door is yours.

The funding product is yours end to end, including funding methods, limits, retries, risk configuration, and partner UX. You won’t be negotiating bank charters. You’ll be deciding what ships, when, and at what balance of friction against compliance. You’ll report to the VP of Product, who sets strategy across Financial Services while you own the how and the when for OG.com.

### **What You'll Actually Do:**

* **Own onboarding and funding end to end.** Signup, verify, deposit, time-to-funded. You make the call on where to trade friction for compliance. The job isn’t shipping a KYC screen; it’s getting people from signup to funded to ready for their first trade.
* **Own the funding product.** You decide funding methods, payouts, limits, retries, and partner UX, spanning ACH, cards, instant funding, and whatever else clears in the U.S. Authorization and flow of funds are product decisions to you, not a ticket you file with a vendor.
* **Treat the money-in funnel as a growth surface.** You instrument the drop-off, go after the leaks, and sequence your work against conversion. On the handoff from funded to first contract, you partner with the Predictions PM.
* **Hold the design bar on trust and money UX.** Clarity, hierarchy, and clean error states aren’t negotiable. When someone’s entering a debit card or waiting on an ACH, “good enough” doesn’t cut it, and you’ll say so. Your feedback is specific: interaction cost, copy, recovery paths, not vibes.
* **Wireframe and partner on design.** You build your own wires and drive the design conversation, catching the clunky funding and KYC moments before users hit them.
* **Talk to users like a peer.** You run research on how people really sign up, verify, and move money. You ask them to show you how they fund an account instead of asking whether they’d use instant deposit.
* **Drive cross-functional execution.** You get engineering, design, data, compliance, payments, and ops working toward the same funded-user outcomes. Nothing in onboarding or funding ships without your sign-off on the product and UX bar.

### **Requirements:**

* **Consumer money-in funnel ownership.** You’ve owned a consumer signup-to-deposit-to-funded flow, and you can walk us through the funnel you ran, the drop-offs you went after, and the number that actually moved. That’s the bar. Merchant acquiring, B2B payouts, and adjacent-team contributions don’t count.
* **Hands-on flow-of-funds ownership at the bank-API layer, not just a gateway.** You’ve done real work integrating bank or embedded-banking APIs, whether direct bank and partner-bank APIs or a banking-as-a-service or rails provider, and you’ve owned a funding method, rail, or failure mode end to end. You can point to a specific flow of funds or failure state you ran yourself: a settlement failure, an ACH return or NACHA edge case, a retry model, a routing decision, a chargeback or liability flow. You don’t need to have built a bank core from scratch, but consuming a payment gateway and filing tickets against it won’t clear this bar. The judgment we need comes from having worked at the money layer, so you’re making sound calls on day one.
* **Design sensibility as a product skill.** You can critique money-in and identity UX with specifics like hierarchy, density, recovery, and trust, not just “it looks nicer.” Tell us about a flow you refused to ship until it was clear.
* **An instinct for why funding has to feel instant.** In a live-event context, a slow or failed deposit is volume lost in real time. You’ve designed under that pressure, or you can show us you get it.
* **Data- and user-driven by default.** You instrument your own funnel, size the opportunity, and prioritize off the numbers without waiting for someone to hand you the analysis. You also go to the source, running your own research on how people sign up, verify, and fund, and letting what you learn reshape the roadmap. Both the quantitative and the qualitative.

### **Strong Plus:**

* **KYC / identity depth.** You’ve owned identity verification, step-up, or risk-tiered challenge decisions yourself. (If a peer owned KYC while you owned deposits, that’s fine, but identity fluency helps here.)
* **Regulated on/off-ramp or neobank experience.** You’ve sat at the intersection of compliance, rails, and consumer conversion.
* **Prediction-market, sportsbook, or real-money-gaming background.** You know why funding has to feel instant during a live game.
* **Deep design-tool / design-system fluency.** You move faster treating design as a peer discipline rather than a handoff.
* **AI-augmented product work.** You use AI tools with human judgment in the loop to move faster on research,

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology.
