new_jobs.title: Trust & Safety Product Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

We are hiring a Trust & Safety Product Operations Specialist to investigate safety incidents and work with the Product and Legal teams to prevent the next one. You will report to the Director of Trust & Safety. You will turn what cases and data show into product feedback and process fixes.

This role uses AI throughout. You will prompt it to query data and build tools, and you will answer for what it produces.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Investigations & Policy**

* Run safety investigations from intake through resolution. Weigh conflicting accounts against the evidence, and close each case with a written finding that a second reviewer can verify.
* Handle escalated tickets. Communicate clearly with professionals and partners, and with legal and law enforcement when a case requires it. Tie every resolution to the facts and to our terms.
* Apply Instawork’s Community Guidelines consistently, and propose revisions where cases expose gaps.

### **Data & Metrics**

* Use natural language to generate SQL for our databases. Review each query’s logic and verify its results before you act on them.
* Identify fraud patterns and safety trends yourself, without a technical intermediary. Report what the data supports and where it falls short.
* Track the metrics that show whether Trust & Safety is working, including incident rate, time to first action, appeal overturn rate, and repeat-violation rate. Report results to Product and Legal against targets set by the Director of Trust & Safety.
* Investigate the cause when a metric moves off target, and recommend a response.
* Re-review a sample of closed cases each month to check that findings are accurate and consistent.

### **Product Operations & Automation**

* Test new safety and enforcement features before launch, and send Product written defect reports.
* Help plan outreach to professionals and partners for each new feature, and track adoption from launch.
* Collect and analyze feedback from cases and support channels, and report what it implies for departmental and company planning.
* Build internal tools by prompting AI coding assistants. Check the logic and test the output before a tool touches a live case. Examples include scripts that assemble case evidence and workflows that route incoming reports. Keep data privacy and human review in each tool.
* Find the manual steps that slow investigations and replace them with automation or a tool you build. Maintain what you ship.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 1+ years in Trust & Safety, Operations, or Compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to weigh conflicting accounts and reach a fair finding under pressure, with a habit of checking your own bias.
* Daily professional use of AI to query data and build tools, and a working knowledge of where it fails.
* Fluency in Excel or Google Sheets, and comfort moving through internal systems to assemble facts.
* Experience tracking and reporting operational metrics, and judgment about which ones mislead.
* Ownership of each case until the underlying problem is solved.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* SQL, Python (Pandas), or a BI tool such as Looker or Tableau.
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or Replit, or with no-code tools such as Zapier.
* Experience working with external stakeholders such as clients, legal teams, or law enforcement.
* Experience testing or launching product features.
* Background in a marketplace or labor platform.

* **Always Be Learning**  
  We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* **Act Like an Owner**  
  We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**

Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!

Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.

Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs

We are committed to fostering a work environment where our differences are celebrated and everyone has what they need to thrive-no matter their race, age, ability, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or country of origin. Click here to learn more about what this commitment looks like in action.

 **Job Description**

The 9704 Employment & Training Specialist III performs a variety of employment and training related job functions, including, but not limited to: employer engagement/job development; vocational assessment and career counseling; soft and hard skill employment-related training; job placement; facilitation of program workshops; program coordination; and other appropriate assignments.

* Develop and maintain effective working relationships with employment service providers and inter/intra-agency staff.
* Assist job-ready clients with job search and placement. Locate suitable training sites for placement of participants requiring additional training and experience.
* Collect and compile data, statistical information, and reports as needed; maintain records.

new_jobs.title: Pharmacy Operations Optimization Manager – KitCheck
new_jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

The Pharmacy Operations Optimization Manager is responsible for the engagement health and realized value of Bluesight's KitCheck customer portfolio. KitCheck helps hospital pharmacies process kits and trays faster and more accurately with RFID, but the product only delivers value when pharmacy teams actively scan, keep their formulary and kit masters current, stay ahead on tag and consumable ordering, and use the data to run leaner operations. This role exists to make sure that happens across every account, not just the ones that ask for help.

You will own the full book of business at the cohort level: monitoring engagement and operational performance across all KitCheck customers, identifying accounts drifting toward disengagement before they become renewal risks, and directing the right resource (yourself, an Implementation or Support specialist, or a Customer Success Manager) to get them back on track. You will also build and run the reporting cadence that keeps our internal teams aligned, including a recurring executive summary and regular updates to CSMs on their accounts.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with hands-on experience in hospital pharmacy operations, ideally including kit and tray processing, medication inventory management, or pharmacy automation. A PharmD or CPhT credential is required. You can balance portfolio-level oversight with hands-on customer work, and you are comfortable being the subject matter expert in the room with a pharmacy director, an operations manager, or a buyer.

### **Core Responsibilities**

**Portfolio & Cohort Management:** Own engagement health across the full KitCheck customer base. Maintain a portfolio view of which accounts are actively working the product, which are drifting, and which need intervention, and make sure every at-risk account has a named owner and a plan.

**Engagement Metrics & Reporting:** Define and maintain the KitCheck engagement scorecard (e.g., scanning and kit processing activity, charge and restock turnaround, tag and consumable ordering trends, expired medication capture, active user trends). Publish a recurring executive flash summarizing portfolio health, and send regular account-level updates to CSMs so nothing surprises them at renewal.

**Proactive Account Intervention:** For accounts missing the mark, run the play: diagnose the gap, re-engage the customer directly or deploy the right internal expert, and establish recurring touchpoints (monthly calls, best-practice reviews) until the account is back on track.

**SME Capacity Orchestration:** Direct traffic for pharmacy SME capacity across Implementation, Support, and Professional Services. Proactively scope and assign timeboxed engagements (workflow reviews, kit master cleanups, operational tune-ups, re-training) against the accounts that need them most, alongside the existing CSM-initiated request channel.

**CS & Sales Enablement:** Arm CSMs and Account Managers with engagement and adoption context ahead of QBRs, EBRs, and renewal conversations. Flag accounts that are healthy enough for expansion conversations, and be honest about the ones that are not.

**Best Practices & Thought Leadership:** Develop and maintain the KitCheck Engagement Playbook covering cadences, intervention plays, and communication templates. Lead webinars and customer-facing content that raise the bar on pharmacy operations maturity across the customer base.

**Voice of the Customer:** Represent pharmacy workflow challenges, hardware and consumable friction, and adoption gaps to Product, Engineering, and Supply Chain, particularly where they affect renewal or expansion risk.

### **Qualifications**

**Education & Credentials**

* Bachelor's degree in pharmacy or a related field, or equivalent pharmacy technician experience.
* PharmD or CPhT credential required. Involvement in pharmacy practice communities (e.g., ASHP) is a plus.

**Experience**

* 5+ years in hospital pharmacy operations, including medication inventory management, kit and tray workflows, or pharmacy automation.
* Direct experience running or improving pharmacy operational workflows such as crash cart and tray processing, expiration management, and restocking cadences.
* Familiarity with RFID medication tracking, automated dispensing cabinets, and pharmacy information systems preferred.
* Experience in customer engagement, account management, or implementation within healthcare or hospital systems.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Proven ability to build credible relationships with pharmacy directors, operations managers, and technicians while delivering measurable value.
* Strong data analysis skills: comfortable defining metrics, reading engagement dashboards, and turning trends into intervention plans.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills for both customer-facing and executive audiences.
* Ability to manage a portfolio of accounts and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.

### **Why Join Us**

Hospital pharmacies are asked to do more with less every year, and manual kit and tray processing wastes pharmacist and technician hours that patients need elsewhere. In this role you will directly raise the operational effectiveness of medication kit management across a national portfolio of health systems while shaping how Bluesight scales proactive customer engagement across its product lines. You will work alongside experienced Implementation and Support teams, an established Customer Success organization, and a proven engagement playbook alr

***Patient Access Liaison***  
  
**About Krystal Bio:**  
  
At Krystal Biotech, we bring together the brightest and most eager minds to relentlessly pursue the discovery, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of genetic medicines to treat diseases with high unmet medical needs.  
  
Founded in 2016, Krystal is distinguished in three powerful ways: science and technology using our patented gene therapy platform, innovative manufacturing supported by our commercial scale facilities, and a unique commercialization model that focuses on the patient’s end to end experience.  
  
Krystal received U.S. FDA approval for the first and only redosable gene therapy treatment, VYJUVEK®, for the treatment of Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (DEB). Krystal continues to leverage our proprietary platform to rapidly advance a robust pipeline of investigational genetic medicines in respiratory, oncology, dermatology, and ophthalmology.  
  
Krystal is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA which is home to our two state-of-the-art CGMP manufacturing facilities with teams around the world and satellite offices in Switzerland, Germany, and Japan. We are a company built and run by people who care, are fearless in the face of a challenge, love the work they do, and practice the highest level of scientific integrity. As we grow, we are seeking team members that embody these values.  
  
**Job Description Summary:**  
The Patient Access Liaison (PAL) is a field-based position that will provide product reimbursement, distribution, logistical, and other non-medical educational assistance to patients/caregivers as well as HCP office and site of care staff. The PAL will work with the patient and their health care providers to educate them on the requirements to gain access to therapy including information specific to prior authorization and appeals. The PAL will also work to maintain relationships with the patients and the office staff to support ongoing compliance with prescribed therapy, including as needed collaboration with specialty pharmacy and distributors.  
  
The PAL is a highly visible position and will have an assigned geographic region and requires strong teamwork to provide exceptional customer service to patients, caregivers, HCP staff as well as internal cross-functional teams. The Patient Access Liaisons must have experience in rare diseases including strong knowledge of reimbursement and distribution for buy & bill/medical benefit covered products.  
  
**Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following:**

* Support patients with accessing treatment by educating the patient & office staff about payer access & insurance processes, including specific payer requirements for authorization.

**About Trauma Healing Accelerated**

Trauma Healing Accelerated (THA) is an education organization built on the Biology of Trauma® framework developed by Dr. Aimie Apigian, a double board-certified physician and author of *The Biology of Trauma*. The framework explains how unresolved trauma is held in the body and nervous system, and how it can be addressed through a biology-first approach.

THA serves two audiences: individuals pursuing their own healing, and the coaches, therapists and clinicians who support them. Our programs include the self-paced 21-Day Journey, our flagship Foundational Journey, the Biology of Trauma® modules, yearlong programs for individuals and practitioners, and an online member community. All THA offerings are educational in nature and do not constitute medical advice.

* Location: Remote (team operates on Pacific Time)

* Key relationship: Dr. Aimie Apigian, Founder

The Program Lead is accountable for the delivery and quality of every THA program and for the participant experience from enrollment through completion. The role leads the program management and support team, establishes delivery standards, and ensures participants complete their programs and progress to the next appropriate offering.

This is a systems-oriented leadership position. Apply through Indeed with your resume and a brief summary of a program or tea

* Responsible for supporting the sales tracing, performance rebate, quarterly rebate projections, and supplier marketing programs’ reporting and maintaining the related program elements including invoicing suppliers for monthly/quarterly programs as directed
* Responsible for supporting the tracking and monitoring of distribution agreement compliance and working with Pricing and Support teams to resolve non-compliance issues.

**SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:**

  

* Ability to prioritize and handle multiple projects and daily tasks.

* Working knowledge of data warehouse and Global Vendor reporting.

* Strong knowledge of Excel (complex formulas, pivots, large datasets, financial modeling, scenario analysis, and data manipulation) and PowerPoint.

**GENERAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:**

* Good decision making, analysis and problem solving skills
* Good verbal and written communication skills

**MINIMUM WORK EXPERIENCE:**

  

Typically 2 to 4 years of related professional experience.

  
  

**PREFERRED EDUCATION:**

  

Typically a Bachelor's Degree or global equivalent in related discipline.

  
  

**TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**

FoodCorps is a national nonprofit advancing child well-being through food in school. FoodCorps partners with students, families, and communities to champion nourishing food at local, state, and national levels. Our leaders support schools in providing nutritious meals, locally-informed food education, and welcoming school environments that set kids up for positive, vibrant relationships with food. Building on this program, we develop leaders, grow networks, and advocate for policies in service of every kid’s health and well-being. FoodCorps is working toward a future where all 50 million public school students have access to food education and nourishing meals in school. Learn more at www.foodcorps.org.

**What We Do:**  
Too many children go through the school day without the nutritious food they need to do and feel their best. FoodCorps sets students up for success by working with schools to provide nourishing meals, nutrition education, and community engagement through food. We get kids excited about eating fruits and veggies, support school nutrition staff in bringing locally grown and freshly prepared meals onto lunch trays, and work with families to create positive school food environments for all kids. FoodCorps’ proven programming reaches thousands of students each year, helping to support kids' health, academic progress, and connection to their community through food in school.

**Who We’re Looking For:**
--------------------------

We are seeking a dynamic Food Education Training Manager with strong skills in classroom teaching, curriculum design, adult learning, and project management. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end development and delivery of high-quality FoodCorps member training, while contributing to broader organizational learning initiatives, including supporting curriculum evolution and engaging on the School Food Leadership Network and Micro-credential programs. The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, and tech-savvy. They will build strong collaboration across teams, excel in facilitation and communication, and effectively manage program development and logistics to drive impactful training and leadership development.

This role reports to the Director of Leadership Learning & Design.

This is a Manager level role with a salary of $82,400/yr.

**Areas of responsibility:**
----------------------------

**FoodCorps Member Training, Coaching, and Support:**

* Create and facilitate differentiated virtual and in-person training for FoodCorps members.
* Design and maintain asynchronous training modules in an LMS on food education topics, including reviewing participant work and providing individualized feedback.
* Develop slides and/or co-create slides, materials, prework, and asynchronous activities for FoodCorps member training sessions.
* Source and collaborate with subject matter experts and guest facilitators to design, deliver, or consult on virtual or in-person sessions, overseeing content alignment, session quality, and event logistics.
* Provide coaching, ongoing support, and professional development resources to state-based Managers of Program Impact and mentor teachers at partner sites to enhance program implementation and effectiveness.
* Assist the Director of Leadership Learning & Design in executing the FoodCorps Member formal observation process, providing coaching and calibration support for scorers, reviewing evaluation results, and helping implement process or tech updates.
* Maintain a working knowledge of trends, policies, and current best practices in food education and school nutrition topics.

**Curriculum and Publications Development**

* Support FoodCorps curriculum overhaul and expansion by helping hire, onboard, and project-manage external curriculum developers and consultants, ensuring deliverables align with program goals and feedback cycles.
* Audit and review existing and potential new curriculum resources (including books, supplemental materials, and media) for alignment with the FoodCorps Food Literacy Standards and organizational priorities.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of lesson plans focused on experiential, hands-on food education across four key settings: the classroom, garden, cafeteria, and kitchen/cooking spaces.
* Support the rollout of new curriculum materials, leading member training sessions and modeling hands-on instructional techniques to ensure effective adoption in the field.
* Develop and provide feedback on existing and future FoodCorps print, online, and video publications and resources.

**Network Engagement & Continuing Education**

* Actively engage on the School Food Leadership Network platform, moderating dedicated channels and driving food education discussions.
* Support School Food Leadership training and coaching on food education topics.
* Maintain and support the Food Education Microcredential program, including creating aligned learning resources, managing Slack community engagement, and tracking participant progress.

**General Responsibilities: (In partnership with the School Nutrition Training Manager)**

* Design enriching cohort experiences for participants that build connectivity to one another and loyalty to FoodCorps communities.
* Collaborate with the Director of Leadership Learning & Design to align the program with organizational priorities and outcomes.
* Maintain training calendar and catalog, and online training platforms for FoodCorps members.
* Create instructional resources, Standard Operating Procedure guidance, and maintain internal FoodCorps systems for organizing the work of the Learning and Design Team, making it accessible for all staff.
* Provide tech support for virtual training, webinars, and panel discussions for FoodCorps members.
